# Captured Generals Expanded - all scripted effects merged into one file (original file order kept).

# ===== 00_cge_compat_hooks.txt =====
cge_identify_compat_character_on_from = {
    if = {
        limit = { always = no }
    }
}

cge_assign_compat_generic_portrait = {
    cge_assign_fallback_portrait = yes
}

cge_override_compat_generic_portrait_on_capture = {
}

# ===== cge_capture_site_effects.txt =====
cge_record_capture_site = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        FROM = {
            clear_variable = cge_capture_site_pending_state
            save_event_target_as = cge_capture_site_captor
        }
        set_temp_variable = {
            cge_capture_site_stop = 0
        }
        for_each_loop = {
            array = global.states
            value = cge_capture_site_probe_state
            break = cge_capture_site_stop
            if = {
                limit = {
                    is_in_state = var:cge_capture_site_probe_state
                }
                var:cge_capture_site_probe_state = {
                    event_target:cge_capture_site_captor = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_capture_site_pending_state
                            value = PREV
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_temp_variable = {
                    cge_capture_site_stop = 1
                }
            }
        }
        set_unit_leader_flag = cge_capture_site_subject
        OWNER = {
            every_army_leader = {
                include_invisible = yes
                limit = {
                    has_unit_leader_flag = cge_capture_site_subject
                }
                clr_unit_leader_flag = cge_capture_site_subject
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_native_captor
                    value = event_target:cge_capture_site_captor
                }
                clear_variable = cge_capture_site_state
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        event_target:cge_capture_site_captor = {
                            has_variable = cge_capture_site_pending_state
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_capture_site_state
                        value = event_target:cge_capture_site_captor.cge_capture_site_pending_state
                    }
                }
                else = {
                }
            }
        }
        clr_unit_leader_flag = cge_capture_site_subject
        FROM = {
            clear_variable = cge_capture_site_pending_state
            add_to_variable = {
                cge_main_window_dirty = 1
            }
        }
    }
}

# ===== cge_character_registry.txt =====
cge_clear_capture_temp_data = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_cap_char_key
        clear_variable = cge_cap_name_order
        clear_variable = cge_cap_rank
        clear_variable = cge_cap_state
        clear_variable = cge_cap_level
        clear_variable = cge_cap_attack
        clear_variable = cge_cap_defense
        clear_variable = cge_cap_planning
        clear_variable = cge_cap_logistics
        clear_variable = cge_cap_capacity
        clear_variable = cge_cap_attack_bonus
        clear_variable = cge_cap_defense_bonus
        clear_variable = cge_cap_planning_bonus
        clear_variable = cge_cap_logistics_bonus
        clear_variable = cge_cap_trait_count
        clear_variable = cge_tmp_trait_1
        clear_variable = cge_tmp_trait_2
        clear_variable = cge_tmp_trait_3
        clear_variable = cge_tmp_trait_4
        clear_variable = cge_tmp_trait_5
        clear_variable = cge_tmp_trait_6
        clear_variable = cge_tmp_trait_7
        clear_variable = cge_tmp_trait_8
        clear_variable = cge_cap_prisoner_id
        clear_variable = cge_cap_portrait_key
        clear_variable = cge_cap_domestic_civil_war
    }
}
cge_snapshot_live_stats_on_from = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_cap_attack_bonus
                value = cge_cap_attack
            }
            multiply_variable = {
                var = cge_cap_attack_bonus
                value = 2.5
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_cap_defense_bonus
                value = cge_cap_defense
            }
            multiply_variable = {
                var = cge_cap_defense_bonus
                value = 2.5
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_cap_planning_bonus
                value = cge_cap_planning
            }
            multiply_variable = {
                var = cge_cap_planning_bonus
                value = 2.5
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_cap_logistics_bonus
                value = cge_cap_logistics
            }
            multiply_variable = {
                var = cge_cap_logistics_bonus
                value = 2.5
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                is_field_marshal = yes
            }
            event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                set_variable = {
                    cge_cap_rank = 2
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_cap_capacity = 5
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                set_variable = {
                    cge_cap_rank = 1
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_cap_capacity = 24
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_identify_character_on_from = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_identify_macarthur = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = cge_registry_character_key
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = cge_registry_name_order
                    }
                }
            }
            cge_identify_character_on_from_base = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = cge_registry_character_key
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = cge_registry_name_order
                    }
                }
            }
            cge_identify_compat_character_on_from = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = cge_registry_character_key
            }
            event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_cap_char_key
                    value = PREV.cge_registry_character_key
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_cap_name_order = 1000000
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        PREV = {
                            has_variable = cge_registry_name_order
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_cap_name_order
                        value = PREV.cge_registry_name_order
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

cge_append_capture_trait_id = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_cap_trait_count
                    value = 8
                    compare = less_than
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_tmp_trait_[CGE_POS] = [CGE_ID]
                    }
                }
                CGE_POS = "[?cge_cap_trait_pos|.0]"
                CGE_ID = "[?cge_cap_trait_id|.0]"
            }
            add_to_variable = {
                cge_cap_trait_count = 1
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_cap_trait_pos
        clear_variable = cge_cap_trait_id
    }
}

cge_prepare_capture_snapshot_on_from = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        FROM = {
            cge_clear_capture_temp_data = yes
            save_event_target_as = cge_capture_stats_captor
            clr_country_flag = cge_capture_actual_leader_found
        }
        OWNER = {
            save_event_target_as = cge_capture_origin_country
        }
        FROM = {
            var:original_tag = {
                save_event_target_as = cge_capture_captor_original_tag
            }
        }
        OWNER = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        civilwar_target = event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor
                        AND = {
                            has_civil_war = yes
                            event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                                has_civil_war = yes
                            }
                            original_tag = event_target:cge_capture_captor_original_tag
                        }
                    }
                }
                event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_cap_domestic_civil_war = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        cge_snapshot_live_traits_on_from = yes
        set_unit_leader_flag = cge_capture_resolve_marker
        OWNER = {
            random_army_leader = {
                include_invisible = yes
                limit = {
                    has_unit_leader_flag = cge_capture_resolve_marker
                }
                clr_unit_leader_flag = cge_capture_resolve_marker
                save_event_target_as = cge_capture_actual_leader
                cge_identify_character_on_from = yes
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_cap_char_key
                                value = 1
                                compare = less_than
                            }
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = cge_runtime_portrait_key
                        }
                    }
                    cge_assign_owner_portrait = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_cap_char_key
                                value = 1
                                compare = less_than
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    cge_override_compat_generic_portrait_on_capture = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = cge_runtime_portrait_key
                    }
                    event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_cap_portrait_key
                            value = PREV.cge_runtime_portrait_key
                        }
                    }
                }
                cge_capture_character_stats = yes
                cge_snapshot_live_stats_on_from = yes
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = cge_capture_site_state
                    }
                    event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_cap_state
                            value = PREV.cge_capture_site_state
                        }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_cap_char_key
                                value = 1
                                compare = less_than
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_runtime_prisoner_id
                                value = 1
                                compare = less_than
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                            add_to_variable = {
                                cge_runtime_prisoner_sequence = 1
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_runtime_prisoner_id
                            value = event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor.cge_runtime_prisoner_sequence
                        }
                    }
                    event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_cap_prisoner_id
                            value = PREV.cge_runtime_prisoner_id
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_cap_name_order = 1000000
                        }
                        add_to_variable = {
                            var = cge_cap_name_order
                            value = cge_cap_prisoner_id
                        }
                    }
                }
                event_target:cge_capture_stats_captor = {
                    set_country_flag = cge_capture_actual_leader_found
                }
            }
        }
        clr_unit_leader_flag = cge_capture_resolve_marker
        FROM = {
            if = {

                    NOT = {

            }

                subtract_from_variable = {
                    cge_postwar_candidate_slot_3 = 1
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_copy_dst
                value = cge_remove_slot
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_copy_src
                value = cge_remove_slot
            }
            add_to_variable = {
                cge_copy_src = 1
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = cge_copy_src
                end = cge_captured_general_count
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_compaction_source_index
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_copy_src
                    value = cge_compaction_source_index
                }
                cge_copy_slot_data = yes
                add_to_variable = {
                    cge_copy_dst = 1
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_slot
                value = cge_captured_general_count
            }
            cge_clear_slot_data = yes
            subtract_from_variable = {
                cge_captured_general_count = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_captured_general_count
                        value = 0
                        compare = less_than
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_captured_general_count = 0
                }
            }
            cge_recalc_consumer_penalty = yes
            cge_recalc_patience_modifiers = yes
            add_to_variable = {
                cge_main_window_dirty = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
                    }
                }
                cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_remove_released_generals = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_restore_missing_recruited_records = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = cge_recent_annexation }
            cge_recapture_annex_freed = yes
        }
        cge_liberate_annex_recaptured = yes
        save_event_target_as = cge_cleanup_captor
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = cge_captured_general_count
            end = 1
            add = -1
            compare = greater_than_or_equals
            value = cge_cleanup_slot
            set_variable = {
                cge_keep_slot = 0
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                            OR = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                    OR = {
                                        is_general_captured = yes
                                        has_character_flag = cge_recruited_by_player
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_keep_slot = 1
                        }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^num
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                            var:original_tag = {
                                save_event_target_as = cge_cleanup_origin
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = {
                                    any_enemy_country = {
                                        original_tag = event_target:cge_cleanup_origin
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_keep_slot = 1
                            }
                            set_country_flag = cge_postwar_watch_active
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_cleanup_slot|.0]"
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_keep_slot
                        value = 0
                        compare = equals
                    }
                }
                # MFU: a prisoner who left custody (e.g. freed by a rescue raid) mid-operation refunds the up-front cost
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        if = {
                            limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_timer_running value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
                            if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action value = 1 compare = equals } } add_political_power = 50 }
                            if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action value = 2 compare = equals } } add_command_power = 10 }
                            if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action value = 3 compare = equals } } add_political_power = 100 }
                            if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action value = 5 compare = equals } } add_political_power = 100 }
                            if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action value = 6 compare = equals } } add_political_power = 200 add_manpower = 1 }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_timer_running value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
                            if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_selected_action value = 1 compare = equals } } add_political_power = 50 }
                            if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_selected_action value = 4 compare = equals } } add_command_power = 10 }
                        }
                    }
                    CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_cleanup_slot|.0]"
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_release_slot_to_remove
                    value = cge_cleanup_slot
                }
                cge_release_remove_selected_slot = yes
            }
        }
        cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
    }
}

cge_dedupe_duplicate_slots = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled }
            check_variable = { var = cge_captured_general_count value = 1 compare = greater_than }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_dedupe_found
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_dedupe_slot
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = { has_character_flag = cge_dedupe_seen }
                            }
                            set_variable = { cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_ready = 1 }
                            clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            set_country_flag = cge_dedupe_found
                        }
                        else = {
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = { set_character_flag = cge_dedupe_seen }
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_dedupe_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_dedupe_slot
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader }
                        var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = { clr_character_flag = cge_dedupe_seen }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_dedupe_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_dedupe_slot
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = cge_dedupe_found }
            set_variable = { cge_return_batch_kind = 0 }
            cge_return_remove_ready_slots = yes
            clear_variable = cge_return_batch_kind
            cge_calc_alive_count = yes
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_dedupe_found
    }
}

cge_recapture_annex_freed = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled }
            check_variable = { var = cge_captured_general_count value = 0 compare = greater_than }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_annex_captor
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_annex_slot
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
                            NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                is_unit_leader = yes
                                is_general_captured = no
                                has_character_flag = cge_captured_by_player
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            capture_by = event_target:cge_annex_captor
                            set_character_flag = cge_annex_recaptured
                        }
                        set_country_flag = cge_has_annex_recaptured
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_annex_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_annex_slot
    }
}

cge_liberate_annex_recaptured = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled }
            has_country_flag = cge_has_annex_recaptured
            check_variable = { var = cge_captured_general_count value = 0 compare = greater_than }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_liberation_captor
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_liberation_slot
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_held_state value = 0 compare = greater_than }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                has_character_flag = cge_annex_recaptured
                                is_general_captured = yes
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_held_state = {
                                CONTROLLER = {
                                    has_war_with = event_target:cge_liberation_captor
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            clr_character_flag = cge_annex_recaptured
                            release_from_captivity = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_liberation_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_liberation_slot
        clr_country_flag = cge_has_annex_recaptured
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_liberation_slot
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = { has_character_flag = cge_annex_recaptured }
                        }
                        set_country_flag = cge_has_annex_recaptured
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_liberation_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_liberation_slot
    }
}

        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_global_flag = cge_custody_sync_pending
                }
            }
            set_global_flag = cge_custody_sync_pending
            country_event = {
                id = cge_custody.1
                hours = 2
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_custody_sync_world = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clr_global_flag = cge_custody_sync_pending
        if = {
            limit = {

            }

                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            cge_custody_sync_country = yes
        }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                is_ai = yes
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_captured_general_count
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            cge_recovery_offer_peacetime_prisoners = yes
        }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                is_ai = no
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_captured_general_count
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }

        }

                    value = 0

                }

            cge_negotiation_schedule_next = yes

    }

cge_custody_sync_country = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_custody_holder
        set_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = cge_captured_general_count
            end = 1
            add = -1
            compare = greater_than_or_equals
            value = cge_custody_index
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_custody_general
                            OWNER = { save_event_target_as = cge_custody_owner }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_held_state
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                    has_variable = cge_capture_site_state
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_held_state
                                value = event_target:cge_custody_general.cge_capture_site_state
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                            var:original_tag = {
                                save_event_target_as = cge_custody_origin_tag
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                OR = {
                                    var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                        has_country_flag = cge_postwar_was_at_war_with_player
                                    }
                                    var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                        var:original_tag = {
                                            has_country_flag = cge_postwar_was_at_war_with_player
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                set_character_flag = cge_postwar_tracking_initialized
                                set_character_flag = cge_postwar_war_pending
                            }
                            set_country_flag = cge_postwar_watch_active
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                    NOT = { is_general_captured = yes }
                                    has_character_flag = cge_postwar_war_pending
                                    OR = {
                                        NOT = { has_variable = cge_native_captor }
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_native_captor
                                            value = event_target:cge_custody_holder
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    any_enemy_country = {
                                        original_tag = event_target:cge_custody_origin_tag
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                capture_by = event_target:cge_custody_holder
                                set_variable = {
                                    var = cge_native_captor
                                    value = event_target:cge_custody_holder
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                    has_variable = cge_native_captor
                                    var:cge_native_captor = {
                                        NOT = {
                                            tag = event_target:cge_custody_holder
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            set_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_release_slot_to_remove = [SLOT]
                            }
                            cge_release_remove_selected_slot = yes
                            clr_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                    NOT = { has_character_flag = cge_recruited_by_player }
                                    OR = {
                                        is_general_captured = yes
                                        has_variable = cge_native_captor
                                    }
                                }
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_held_state
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_held_state = {
                                    CONTROLLER = {
                                        exists = yes
                                        NOT = {
                                            tag = event_target:cge_custody_holder
                                        }
                                        NOT = { tag = event_target:cge_custody_owner }
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = original_tag
                                            value = event_target:cge_custody_holder.original_tag
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_held_state = {
                                CONTROLLER = {
                                    save_event_target_as = cge_custody_destination
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_custody_transfer_slot = [SLOT]
                            }
                            cge_custody_transfer_record = yes
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                cge_deferred_mode_active = yes
                                event_target:cge_custody_origin_tag = { exists = no }
                                event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                    NOT = { is_general_captured = yes }
                                    NOT = { has_character_flag = cge_recruited_by_player }
                                }
                            }
                            event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                if = {
                                    limit = { is_unit_leader = yes }
                                    capture_by = event_target:cge_custody_holder
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    var = cge_native_captor
                                    value = event_target:cge_custody_holder
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                    NOT = { is_general_captured = yes }
                                    NOT = { has_character_flag = cge_postwar_war_pending }
                                }
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                        has_character_flag = cge_recruited_by_player
                                    }
                                }
                                set_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
                            }
                            else = {
                                event_target:cge_custody_general = {
                                    cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                    clear_variable = cge_native_captor
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = { cge_release_slot_to_remove = [SLOT] }
                            cge_release_remove_selected_slot = yes
                            clr_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_custody_index|.0]"
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
        cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
    }
}

        }

            save_event_target_as = cge_custody_holder
        }
    }
}
cge_custody_import_record = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_custody_already_present
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = cge_captured_general_count
            end = 1
            add = -1
            compare = greater_than_or_equals
            value = cge_custody_import_index
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                                value = event_target:cge_roster_general
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_captor_country^0 = { tag = PREV }
                            }
                            set_country_flag = cge_custody_already_present
                            set_variable = { cge_slot = [SLOT] }
                            cge_mirror_slot_to_character = yes
                        }
                        else = {
                            set_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
                            set_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
                            set_variable = { cge_release_slot_to_remove = [SLOT] }
                            cge_release_remove_selected_slot = yes
                            clr_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
                            clr_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_custody_import_index|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_custody_already_present
                }
            }
            event_target:cge_roster_general = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_cge_origin_country^num
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    OWNER = {
                        save_event_target_as = cge_custody_import_origin
                    }
                    clear_array = cge_cge_origin_country
                    add_to_array = {
                        array = cge_cge_origin_country
                        value = event_target:cge_custody_import_origin
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_cge_level
                        value = skill_level
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_cge_rank_key = 1
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            is_field_marshal = yes
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_cge_rank_key = 2
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_cge_patience = 75
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_cge_cooperation = 25
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_variable = cge_capture_site_state
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_cge_held_state
                            value = cge_capture_site_state
                        }
                    }
                }
                clr_character_flag = cge_roster_retired
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_custody_importing
            cge_restore_recruited_record = yes
            clr_country_flag = cge_custody_importing
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_custody_already_present
    }
}

cge_custody_rebind_ended_civil_war = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled } }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                is_ai = yes
                check_variable = { var = cge_captured_general_count value = 0 compare = greater_than }
            }
            save_event_target_as = cge_custody_rebind_holder
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = cge_captured_general_count
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_custody_rebind_index
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                                NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
                                NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
                                check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_civil_war_successor^num value = 0 compare = greater_than }
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_civil_war_successor^0 = { tag = event_target:cge_return_civil_war_winner }
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                    OWNER = {
                                        OR = {
                                            tag = event_target:cge_return_civil_war_loser
                                            tag = event_target:cge_custody_rebind_holder
                                        }
                                    }
                                    check_variable = { var = cge_native_captor value = PREV compare = equals }
                                }
                            }
                            clear_array = cge_general_display_characters
                            save_event_target_as = cge_return_captor
                            event_target:cge_return_civil_war_winner = { save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination }
                            set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                            set_variable = { var = cge_return_identity_key value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_character_key }
                            set_variable = { var = cge_return_lookup_prisoner_id value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_prisoner_id }
                            cge_return_bind_native_identity = yes
                            if = {
                                limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_return_native_bound value = 0 compare = equals } }
                                cge_return_bind_native_prisoner_id = yes
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    check_variable = { var = cge_return_native_bound value = 1 compare = equals }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader value = cge_return_native_general^0 compare = equals }
                                    }
                                }
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = { save_event_target_as = cge_custody_old_copy }
                                var:cge_return_native_general^0 = { save_event_target_as = cge_custody_surviving_copy }
                                set_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader value = event_target:cge_custody_surviving_copy }
                                event_target:cge_custody_old_copy = {
                                    cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                    clear_variable = cge_native_captor
                                    if = {
                                        limit = { is_unit_leader = yes OWNER = { exists = yes } }
                                        retire = yes
                                    }
                                }
                                event_target:cge_custody_surviving_copy = {
                                    set_character_flag = cge_captured_by_player
                                    clr_character_flag = cge_roster_retired
                                    if = {
                                        limit = { NOT = { is_general_captured = yes } }
                                        capture_by = event_target:cge_custody_rebind_holder
                                        set_variable = { var = cge_native_captor value = event_target:cge_custody_rebind_holder }
                                    }
                                    else_if = {
                                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cge_native_captor } }
                                        set_variable = { var = cge_native_captor value = event_target:cge_custody_rebind_holder }
                                    }
                                }
                                set_variable = { cge_slot = [SLOT] }
                                cge_mirror_slot_to_character = yes
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_recipient
                                    var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_recipient = { exists = no }
                                }
                                set_variable = { cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_state = 0 }
                                clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_recipient
                            }
                            clr_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                        }
                    }
                    SLOT = "[?cge_custody_rebind_index|.0]"
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_custody_bootstrap = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_global_flag = cge_megapatch_custody_initialized
                }
            }
            set_global_flag = cge_megapatch_custody_initialized
            every_country = {
                limit = {
                    has_any_captured_general = yes
                }
                every_army_leader = {
                    include_invisible = yes
                    limit = {
                        is_general_captured = yes
                        has_variable = cge_native_captor
                    }
                    save_event_target_as = cge_roster_general
                    var:cge_native_captor = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                exists = yes
                            }
                            cge_custody_import_record = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

cge_calc_alive_count = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_alive_count_work
            value = cge_captured_general_count
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_alive_loop_slot
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                            OR = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        subtract_from_variable = {
                            cge_alive_count_work = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_alive_loop_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_alive_loop_slot
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_alive_count_work
                    value = 0
                    compare = less_than
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_alive_count_work = 0
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_alive_captured_general_count
            value = cge_alive_count_work
        }
    }
}

                        NOT = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_suicide
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                is_general_captured = yes
                            }
                            event_target:cge_execution_repair_captor = {
                                clear_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                clear_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_character_removed
                                clear_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_execution_date
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_daily_slot|.0]"
        }
    }

cge_slot_finish_execution = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader }
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = { is_general_captured = yes } # MFU: skip generals freed by a rescue raid
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_operation_pending
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action
                            value = 6
                            compare = equals
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_timer_running
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than

                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    clear_global_event_target = cge_execution_captor
                    clear_global_event_target = cge_execution_origin
                    clear_global_event_target = cge_execution_general
                    clear_array = cge_execution_captor_display
                    clear_array = cge_execution_origin_display
                    clear_array = cge_execution_general_display

                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation
                                value = 100
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation = 100
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation
                                value = 0
                                compare = less_than
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation = 0
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_ctx = [CGE_SLOT]
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_history_op_tmp
                        value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_selected_action
                    }
                    add_to_variable = {
                        cge_history_op_tmp = 6
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_history_variant_tmp = 1
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_selected_action
                                value = 3
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_history_delta_tmp
                            value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation
                        }
                        subtract_from_variable = {
                            var = cge_history_delta_tmp
                            value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_pre_cooperation
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_history_delta_tmp
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_history_variant_tmp = 2
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_selected_action
                                value = 5
                                compare = equals
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_history_variant_tmp = 2
                        }
                    }
                    cge_history_add_cooperation = yes
                    clear_variable = cge_history_delta_tmp
                    clear_variable = cge_history_variant_tmp
                    clear_variable = cge_history_op_tmp
                    clear_variable = cge_slot_ctx
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_operation_pending = 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_selected_action = 0
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_overview_selected_slot
                                value = [CGE_SLOT]
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_patience = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_cooperation = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_patience_selected_action = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_cooperation_selected_action = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_patience_timer_running = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_timer_running
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_cooperation_timer_running = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_cooperation_timer_progress = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_cooperation_timer_days_left = 30
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_daily_slot|.0]"
        }

cge_recalc_consumer_penalty = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_cooperation_consumer_goods_factor = 0
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_loop_slot
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_daily_slot
                value = cge_loop_slot
            }
            cge_slot_calc_consumer_penalty = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_cooperation_consumer_goods_factor
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        has_dynamic_modifier = {
                            modifier = cge_cooperation_consumer_goods_penalty
                        }
                    }
                }
                add_dynamic_modifier = {
                    modifier = cge_cooperation_consumer_goods_penalty
                }
            }
            force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                has_dynamic_modifier = {
                    modifier = cge_cooperation_consumer_goods_penalty
                }
            }
            remove_dynamic_modifier = {
                modifier = cge_cooperation_consumer_goods_penalty
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_daily_slot
    }
}
