# ===== cge_deferred_repatriation_effects.txt =====

cge_deferred_snapshot_country = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            cge_deferred_mode_active = yes
            NOT = { has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled }
            exists = yes
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_deferred_rec_origin
        capital_scope = {
            PREV = {
                set_variable = { cge_deferred_capital = PREV }
            }
        }
        clear_array = cge_deferred_owned_cores
        var:original_tag = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { tag = event_target:cge_deferred_rec_origin } }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_deferred_capital
                    value = PREV.cge_deferred_capital
                }
                clear_array = cge_deferred_owned_cores
            }
        }
        every_owned_state = {
            limit = {
                is_core_of = event_target:cge_deferred_rec_origin
            }
            save_event_target_as = cge_deferred_rec_state
            event_target:cge_deferred_rec_origin = {
                add_to_array = {
                    array = cge_deferred_owned_cores
                    value = event_target:cge_deferred_rec_state
                }
                var:original_tag = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                is_in_array = {
                                    array = cge_deferred_owned_cores
                                    value = event_target:cge_deferred_rec_state
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_deferred_owned_cores
                            value = event_target:cge_deferred_rec_state
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        every_enemy_country = {
            save_event_target_as = cge_deferred_rec_ally
            event_target:cge_deferred_rec_origin = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            is_in_array = {
                                array = cge_deferred_cobelligerents
                                value = event_target:cge_deferred_rec_ally
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_array = {
                        array = cge_deferred_cobelligerents
                        value = event_target:cge_deferred_rec_ally
                    }
                }
                var:original_tag = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                is_in_array = {
                                    array = cge_deferred_cobelligerents
                                    value = event_target:cge_deferred_rec_ally
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_deferred_cobelligerents
                            value = event_target:cge_deferred_rec_ally
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

cge_deferred_find_recipient = {
    clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found
    clear_global_event_target = cge_deferred_recipient
    save_event_target_as = cge_deferred_captor
    event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_civil_war_successor^num
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                var:cge_return_civil_war_successor^0 = {
                    exists = yes
                    any_owned_state = { always = yes }
                    NOT = { tag = event_target:cge_deferred_captor }
                    NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cge_deferred_captor }
                }
            }
            var:cge_return_civil_war_successor^0 = {
                save_global_event_target_as = cge_deferred_recipient
            }
            event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                set_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found }
        }
        set_variable = { cge_deferred_best_score = -1 }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                is_subject_of = event_target:cge_deferred_captor
                cge_deferred_is_origin_successor_state = yes
            }
            save_event_target_as = cge_deferred_candidate
            event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                set_variable = { cge_deferred_score = 0 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = original_tag
                        value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin.original_tag
                        compare = equals
                    }
                }
                event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                    add_to_variable = { cge_deferred_score = 2000 }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
                        has_variable = cge_deferred_capital
                        var:cge_deferred_capital = {
                            is_owned_by = event_target:cge_deferred_candidate
                        }
                    }
                }
                event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                    add_to_variable = { cge_deferred_score = 1000 }
                }
            }
            every_owned_state = {
                limit = {
                    is_core_of = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
                }
                event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                    add_to_variable = { cge_deferred_score = 1 }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_deferred_score
                            value = cge_deferred_best_score
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                }
                event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_deferred_best_score
                        value = cge_deferred_score
                    }
                }
                save_global_event_target_as = cge_deferred_recipient
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = { var = cge_deferred_best_score value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found
        }
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_best_score
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_score
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found }
        }
        set_variable = { var = cge_deferred_cb_n value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin.cge_deferred_cobelligerents^num }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 0
            end = cge_deferred_cb_n
            compare = less_than
            value = cge_deferred_cb_i
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
                        var:cge_deferred_cobelligerents^[I] = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = { event_target:cge_deferred_captor = { has_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found } }
                                exists = yes
                                any_owned_state = { always = yes }
                                NOT = { tag = event_target:cge_deferred_captor }
                                NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cge_deferred_captor }
                                NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:cge_deferred_captor }
                            }
                            save_event_target_as = cge_deferred_candidate
                            event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                                cge_deferred_check_same_nation = yes
                                if = {
                                    limit = { has_country_flag = cge_deferred_same_nation }
                                    event_target:cge_deferred_candidate = {
                                        save_global_event_target_as = cge_deferred_recipient
                                    }
                                    set_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found
                                }
                                clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_same_nation
                            }
                        }
                        }
                    }
                }
                I = "[?cge_deferred_cb_i|.0]"
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_cb_n
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_cb_i
    }
}

cge_deferred_check_same_nation = {
    clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_same_nation
    if = {
        limit = {
            event_target:cge_deferred_candidate = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = original_tag
                    value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin.original_tag
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
        }
        set_country_flag = cge_deferred_same_nation
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { cge_deferred_core_total = 0 }
        set_variable = { cge_deferred_core_shared = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
                    check_variable = { var = cge_deferred_owned_cores^num value = 0 compare = greater_than }
                }
            }
            event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
                for_each_scope_loop = {
                    array = cge_deferred_owned_cores
                    event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                        add_to_variable = { cge_deferred_core_total = 1 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                is_core_of = event_target:cge_deferred_candidate
                                is_claimed_by = event_target:cge_deferred_candidate
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                            add_to_variable = { cge_deferred_core_shared = 1 }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            every_state = {
                limit = {
                    is_core_of = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
                }
                event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                    add_to_variable = { cge_deferred_core_total = 1 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            is_core_of = event_target:cge_deferred_candidate
                            is_claimed_by = event_target:cge_deferred_candidate
                        }
                    }
                    event_target:cge_deferred_captor = {
                        add_to_variable = { cge_deferred_core_shared = 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = { var = cge_deferred_core_total value = 0 compare = greater_than }
            }
            set_variable = { cge_deferred_core_ratio = cge_deferred_core_shared }
            divide_variable = { cge_deferred_core_ratio = cge_deferred_core_total }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = { var = cge_deferred_core_ratio value = 0.75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
                    event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { has_variable = cge_deferred_capital }
                            var:cge_deferred_capital = {
                                OR = {
                                    is_core_of = event_target:cge_deferred_candidate
                                    is_claimed_by = event_target:cge_deferred_candidate
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_deferred_same_nation
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_core_total
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_core_shared
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_core_ratio
    }
}

cge_deferred_defer_origin = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                is_in_array = {
                    array = cge_deferred_origins
                    value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
                }
            }
        }
        add_to_array = {
            array = cge_deferred_origins
            value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                is_in_array = {
                    array = cge_deferred_announced
                    value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
                }
            }
        }
        add_to_array = {
            array = cge_deferred_announced
            value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
        }
        clear_array = cge_deferred_display_origin
        add_to_array = {
            array = cge_deferred_display_origin
            value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
        }
        country_event = {
            id = cge_postwar.20
            hours = 2
        }
    }
}

cge_deferred_recheck = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            cge_deferred_mode_active = yes
            NOT = { has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled }
            NOT = { has_country_flag = cge_postwar_queue_active }
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_deferred_origins^num
                value = 0
                compare = greater_than
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_recheck_pending
        clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_requeued
        set_variable = { var = cge_deferred_n value = cge_deferred_origins^num }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = cge_deferred_n
            end = 0
            add = -1
            compare = greater_than
            value = cge_deferred_i
            set_variable = { var = cge_deferred_e value = cge_deferred_i }
            subtract_from_variable = { cge_deferred_e = 1 }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    var:cge_deferred_origins^[E] = {
                        save_global_event_target_as = cge_postwar_origin
                    }
                }
                E = "[?cge_deferred_e|.0]"
            }
            cge_deferred_find_recipient = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found
                }
                remove_from_array = {
                    array = cge_deferred_origins
                    value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
                }
                add_to_array = {
                    array = cge_postwar_origin_queue
                    value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_deferred_requeued
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found
        }
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_n
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_i
        clear_variable = cge_deferred_e
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_origin
        clear_global_event_target = cge_deferred_recipient
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_deferred_requeued
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_requeued
            set_country_flag = cge_postwar_queue_active
            country_event = {
                id = cge_postwar.1
                hours = 1
            }
        }
    }
}

cge_deferred_gate_origin = {
    clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_skip_origin
    if = {
        limit = {
            cge_deferred_mode_active = yes
            event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
                exists = no
            }
            NOT = {
                any_enemy_country = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = original_tag
                        value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin.original_tag
                        compare = equals
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        cge_deferred_find_recipient = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found
            }
            event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
                clear_array = cge_return_civil_war_successor
                add_to_array = {
                    array = cge_return_civil_war_successor
                    value = event_target:cge_deferred_recipient
                }
            }
            remove_from_array = {
                array = cge_deferred_origins
                value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
            }
        }
        else = {
            cge_postwar_mark_origin_family = yes
            cge_deferred_defer_origin = yes
            set_country_flag = cge_deferred_skip_origin
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_recipient_found
        clear_global_event_target = cge_deferred_recipient
    }
}

cge_deferred_request_recheck = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            cge_deferred_mode_active = yes
            NOT = { has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled }
        }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                is_ai = no
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_deferred_origins^num
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_deferred_recheck_pending
            cge_deferred_recheck = yes
        }
    }
}


cge_deferred_snapshot_cores = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            cge_deferred_mode_active = yes
            NOT = { has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled }
            any_core_state = { always = yes }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_deferred_core_origin
        clear_array = cge_deferred_core_states
        every_core_state = {
            event_target:cge_deferred_core_origin = {
                add_to_array = { array = cge_deferred_core_states value = PREV }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:original_tag = { NOT = { tag = event_target:cge_deferred_core_origin } }
            }
            var:original_tag = {
                clear_array = cge_deferred_core_states
            }
            every_core_state = {
                save_event_target_as = cge_deferred_core_state
                event_target:cge_deferred_core_origin = {
                    var:original_tag = {
                        add_to_array = { array = cge_deferred_core_states value = event_target:cge_deferred_core_state }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

cge_trial_prepare_slot = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_slot_ctx
            value = event_target:cge_trial_general.cge_cge_slot_index
        }
    }
}
cge_trial_finish_slot_refresh = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_slot_ctx
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_slot_ctx
                    value = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_slot
                value = cge_slot_ctx
            }
            cge_mirror_slot_to_character = yes
            clear_variable = cge_slot
        }
        clear_variable = cge_slot_ctx
    }
}

                            compare = greater_than

                                compare = greater_than

                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }

                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_route = 1
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_publicity = 10
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_stage = 1
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot_ctx|.0]"

    }

cge_exchange_refresh_selected_partner = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_exchange_ui_partner
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_cache_valid
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                has_variable = cge_selected_general
                has_variable = cge_selected_origin
            }
            save_event_target_as = cge_exchange_ui_player
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_exchange_ui_partner
                value = cge_selected_origin
            }
            var:cge_selected_general = {
                OWNER = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                tag = event_target:cge_exchange_ui_player
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_exchange_ui_player = {
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_exchange_ui_partner
                                value = PREV
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            }

            }
        }
    }
}
cge_exchange_find_offer_slot = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_exchange_offer_slot = 0
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_exchange_scan_slot
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                                value = event_target:cge_exchange_offered_general
                                compare = equals
                            }
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_capture_order
                                value = cge_exchange_offer_capture_order
                                compare = equals
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_exchange_offer_slot = [SLOT]
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_exchange_scan_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
    }
}

            }
        }
    }
}
cge_exchange_collect_candidates = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_array = cge_exchange_candidates
        clr_country_flag = cge_exchange_sole_captor
        set_variable = {
            cge_exchange_unknown_count = 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_any_general_captured_by = event_target:cge_exchange_enemy
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    any_army_leader = {
                        include_invisible = yes
                        is_general_captured = yes
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = cge_native_captor
                        }
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        any_country = {
                            NOT = {
                                tag = event_target:cge_exchange_enemy
                            }
                            event_target:cge_exchange_player = {
                                has_any_general_captured_by = PREV
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_exchange_sole_captor
            }
            every_army_leader = {
                include_invisible = yes
                limit = {
                    is_unit_leader = yes
                    is_general_captured = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = cge_native_captor
                        }
                        event_target:cge_exchange_player = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_exchange_sole_captor
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_native_captor
                        value = event_target:cge_exchange_enemy
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        cge_exchange_candidate_is_eligible = yes
                    }
                    event_target:cge_exchange_player = {
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_exchange_candidates
                            value = PREV
                        }
                    }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = cge_native_captor
                        }
                    }
                    event_target:cge_exchange_player = {
                        add_to_variable = {
                            cge_exchange_unknown_count = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_exchange_sole_captor
    }
}

            }

                value = cge_exchange_requested_level

                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than_or_equals
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_exchange_acceptance = 80

                limit = {

                        var = cge_exchange_level_delta
                        value = -1
                        compare = greater_than_or_equals
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_exchange_acceptance = 55
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_exchange_level_delta
                        value = -2
                        compare = greater_than_or_equals
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {

cge_exchange_build_page = {
    if = {

            NOT = {

            }
        }
        cge_exchange_restore_targets = yes
        cge_exchange_find_offer_slot = yes

        clear_array = cge_exchange_candidate_2
        clear_array = cge_exchange_candidate_3

        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_exchange_candidate_2_skill = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_exchange_candidate_3_skill = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_exchange_page_count = 0
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_exchange_has_more
        clear_array = cge_exchange_candidates
        if = {
            limit = {

                    value = 1
                    compare = equals
                }
                cge_exchange_offer_is_valid = yes
            }

            cge_exchange_collect_candidates = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {

                        value = cge_exchange_candidates^num
                        compare = greater_than_or_equals
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_exchange_offset = 0
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_exchange_cursor
                value = cge_exchange_offset
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_exchange_page_capacity = 3
            }
            if = {
                limit = {

                        value = 0

                        var = cge_exchange_candidates^num
                        value = 3
                        compare = greater_than
                    }

                set_variable = {
                    cge_exchange_page_capacity = 2
                }
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = cge_exchange_page_capacity
                compare = less_than_or_equals

                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_exchange_cursor
                            value = cge_exchange_candidates^num
                            compare = less_than
                        }
                    }
                    meta_effect = {
                        text = {
                            add_to_array = {
                                array = cge_exchange_candidate_[ROW]
                                value = cge_exchange_candidates^cge_exchange_cursor
                            }
                            var:cge_exchange_candidate_[ROW]^0 = {
                                event_target:cge_exchange_player = {
                                    set_variable = {
                                        var = cge_exchange_candidate_[ROW]_skill
                                        value = PREV.skill_level
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        ROW = "[?cge_exchange_page_row|.0]"
                    }
                    add_to_variable = {
                        cge_exchange_cursor = 1
                    }
                    add_to_variable = {
                        cge_exchange_page_count = 1
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_exchange_cursor
                        value = cge_exchange_candidates^num
                        compare = less_than
                    }
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_exchange_has_more
            }
        }
    }

cge_exchange_choose = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_exchange_active
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_exchange_stage
                    value = 1
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            clear_array = cge_exchange_requested
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_exchange_candidate_[CHOICE]^num
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_exchange_requested
                            value = cge_exchange_candidate_[CHOICE]^0
                        }
                    }
                }
                CHOICE = "[?cge_exchange_choice|.0]"
            }
            cge_exchange_restore_targets = yes
            cge_exchange_find_offer_slot = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    event_target:cge_exchange_offered_general = {
                        NOT = { has_character_flag = cge_exchange_cooldown }
                    }
                    cge_exchange_offer_is_valid = yes
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_exchange_requested^num
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                    event_target:cge_exchange_requested_general = {
                        cge_exchange_candidate_is_eligible = yes
                    }
                    has_any_general_captured_by = event_target:cge_exchange_enemy
                }
                cge_exchange_update_chance = yes
                set_variable = {
                    cge_exchange_stage = 5
                }
                event_target:cge_exchange_offered_general = {
                    set_character_flag = {
                        flag = cge_exchange_cooldown
                        days = 100
                        value = 1
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = { var = cge_exchange_acceptance value = 90 compare = equals }
                    }
                    random_list = { 90 = { cge_exchange_accept = yes } 10 = { cge_exchange_refuse = yes } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = { var = cge_exchange_acceptance value = 85 compare = equals }
                    }
                    random_list = { 85 = { cge_exchange_accept = yes } 15 = { cge_exchange_refuse = yes } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = { var = cge_exchange_acceptance value = 80 compare = equals }
                    }
                    random_list = { 80 = { cge_exchange_accept = yes } 20 = { cge_exchange_refuse = yes } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = { var = cge_exchange_acceptance value = 55 compare = equals }
                    }
                    random_list = { 55 = { cge_exchange_accept = yes } 45 = { cge_exchange_refuse = yes } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = { var = cge_exchange_acceptance value = 30 compare = equals }
                    }
                    random_list = { 30 = { cge_exchange_accept = yes } 70 = { cge_exchange_refuse = yes } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = { var = cge_exchange_acceptance value = 15 compare = equals }
                    }
                    random_list = { 15 = { cge_exchange_accept = yes } 85 = { cge_exchange_refuse = yes } }
                }
                else = {
                    random_list = { 5 = { cge_exchange_accept = yes } 95 = { cge_exchange_refuse = yes } }
                }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = {
                    cge_exchange_stage = 4
                }
                country_event = {
                    id = cge_exchange.5
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

cge_negotiation_resolve_partner = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_return_captor
        clr_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
        clr_country_flag = cge_return_country_is_subject
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_partner_best_score = -1
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                cge_deferred_mode_active = yes
                event_target:cge_return_origin = {
                    exists = no
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_return_civil_war_successor^num
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                    var:cge_return_civil_war_successor^0 = {
                        exists = yes
                        any_owned_state = { always = yes }
                        NOT = { tag = event_target:cge_return_captor }
                        NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cge_return_captor }
                    }
                }
            }
            event_target:cge_return_origin = {
                var:cge_return_civil_war_successor^0 = {
                    save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                    if = {
                        limit = { is_subject_of = event_target:cge_return_captor }
                        event_target:cge_return_captor = { set_country_flag = cge_return_country_is_subject }
                    }
                }
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
            set_variable = {
                cge_negotiation_partner_best_score = 100000
            }
        }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                is_subject_of = event_target:cge_return_captor
                any_owned_state = {
                    always = yes
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_war_with = event_target:cge_return_captor
                }
                NOT = {
                    tag = event_target:cge_return_captor

                check_variable = {
                    var = original_tag
                    value = event_target:cge_return_origin.original_tag
                    compare = equals
                }

            set_variable = {
                var = cge_negotiation_partner_candidate_score
                value = num_owned_states
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_negotiation_partner_candidate_score
                        value = event_target:cge_return_captor.cge_negotiation_partner_best_score
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_negotiation_partner_best_score
                        value = PREV.cge_negotiation_partner_candidate_score
                    }
                    set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                    set_country_flag = cge_return_country_is_subject
                }
            }
            clear_variable = cge_negotiation_partner_candidate_score
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_negotiation_partner_best_score = -1

            every_country = {

                    is_dynamic_country = yes

                        is_core_of = event_target:cge_return_origin
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        has_war_with = event_target:cge_return_captor
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        tag = event_target:cge_return_captor
                    }

                set_variable = {

                    value = num_owned_states
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_partner_candidate_score
                            value = event_target:cge_return_captor.cge_negotiation_partner_best_score
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                    save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                    event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_partner_best_score
                            value = PREV.cge_negotiation_partner_candidate_score
                        }
                        set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                        set_country_flag = cge_return_country_is_subject
                    }

            }

            event_target:cge_return_origin = {

                        }
                        save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                        event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                            set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found

                    }
                }
            }

            set_variable = {

                        compare = equals

                    has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_negotiation_partner_best_score = -1
            }
            every_country = {
                limit = {
                    is_dynamic_country = yes
                    any_owned_state = {
                        is_core_of = event_target:cge_return_origin

cge_negotiation_prepare_offer = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_captor
        clr_country_flag = cge_negotiation_partner_found
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_offer_count = 0
        }
        event_target:cge_negotiation_offer_origin = {
            save_event_target_as = cge_return_origin
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_negotiation_probe
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_state
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = original_tag
                                    value = event_target:cge_negotiation_offer_origin.original_tag
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_variable = {
                            cge_negotiation_offer_count = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_negotiation_probe|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_negotiation_offer_count
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                NOT = {
                    any_enemy_country = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = original_tag
                            value = event_target:cge_negotiation_offer_origin.original_tag
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            cge_negotiation_resolve_partner = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                    event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                        NOT = {
                            tag = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            has_war_with = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_negotiation_partner_found
                event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                    save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_offer_partner
                    save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_partner_country
                }
                clear_array = cge_general_display_characters
                clr_country_flag = cge_show_overview_window
                add_to_variable = {
                    cge_negotiation_sequence = 1
                }
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        clear_array = cge_negotiation_[GROUP]_origin
                        clear_array = cge_negotiation_[GROUP]_partner
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_negotiation_[GROUP]_origin
                            value = event_target:cge_negotiation_offer_origin
                        }
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_negotiation_[GROUP]_partner
                            value = event_target:cge_negotiation_offer_partner
                        }
                    }
                    GROUP = "[?cge_negotiation_sequence|.0]"
                }
                for_loop_effect = {
                    start = 1
                    end = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                    value = cge_negotiation_mark_slot
                    meta_effect = {
                        text = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_state
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = original_tag
                                            value = event_target:cge_negotiation_offer_origin.original_tag
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_state = 1
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_group
                                    value = cge_negotiation_sequence
                                }
                                clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_pending
                                clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_ready
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_negotiation_work_slot = [SLOT]
                                }
                                cge_negotiation_hold_slot = yes
                            }
                        }
                        SLOT = "[?cge_negotiation_mark_slot|.0]"
                    }
                }
                add_to_array = {
                    array = cge_negotiation_queue
                    value = cge_negotiation_sequence
                }
                cge_negotiation_schedule_next = yes
                cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_offer_count
    }
}

cge_negotiation_hold_slot = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_captor
        save_event_target_as = cge_return_captor
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_custody_bound = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_duplicate_found = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_native_bound = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_identity_key = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_lookup_prisoner_id = 0
        }
        clear_array = cge_return_native_general
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_identity_key
                    value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_character_key
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_lookup_prisoner_id
                    value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_prisoner_id
                }
                event_target:cge_negotiation_partner_country = {
                    save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_identity_key
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                    cge_return_bind_native_identity = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_native_bound
                            value = 0
                            compare = equals
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_lookup_prisoner_id
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                    cge_return_bind_native_prisoner_id = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_native_bound
                            value = 0
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    cge_negotiation_bind_partner_alias = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_native_bound
                            value = 0
                            compare = equals
                        }
                        has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                    }
                    var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                is_character = ETH_haile_selassie_gugsa
                            }
                            event_target:cge_negotiation_partner_country = {
                                every_character = {
                                    limit = { is_character = ITA_haile_selassie_gugsa_doppleganger }
                                    cge_negotiation_bind_alias_character = yes
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                clr_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_native_bound
                            value = 1
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    var:cge_return_native_general^0 = {
                        save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_custody_general
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_negotiation_custody_bound = 1
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                                    value = event_target:cge_negotiation_custody_general
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_duplicate
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_negotiation_duplicate_found = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                    }
                    var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                        save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_custody_general
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_negotiation_custody_bound = 1
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_custody_bound
                            value = 1
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        value = event_target:cge_negotiation_custody_general
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_negotiation_duplicate_found
                                value = 1
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_negotiation_duplicate = {
                            cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                            clear_variable = cge_native_captor
                            retire = yes
                        }
                    }
                    event_target:cge_negotiation_custody_general = {
                        set_character_flag = cge_captured_by_player
                        clr_character_flag = cge_roster_retired
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                is_general_captured = no
                            }
                            capture_by = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_native_captor
                                value = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot = [SLOT]
                    }
                    cge_mirror_slot_to_character = yes
                }
            }
            SLOT = "[?cge_negotiation_work_slot|.0]"
        }
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_custody_bound
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_duplicate_found
        clear_variable = cge_return_identity_key
        clear_variable = cge_return_lookup_prisoner_id
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_native_bound = 0
        }
        clear_array = cge_return_native_general
        clr_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
    }
}
cge_negotiation_offer_before_reconcile = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_binding_custody
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_state
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_civil_war_successor^num
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_resume_dead_slot
                            value = cge_return_dead_scan_slot
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_offer_origin
                        }
                        cge_negotiation_prepare_offer = yes
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_dead_scan_slot
                            value = cge_negotiation_resume_dead_slot
                        }
                        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_resume_dead_slot
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_return_dead_scan_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_negotiation_schedule_next = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = cge_negotiation_active_group
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_event_scheduled
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_negotiation_queue^num
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_global_flag = cge_custody_sync_pending
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_global_flag = cge_custody_settlement_pending
                }
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_negotiation_event_scheduled
            country_event = {
                id = cge_negotiations.10
                hours = 1
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_negotiation_begin_next = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_negotiation_event_scheduled
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = cge_negotiation_active_group
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_negotiation_queue^num
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_negotiation_active_group
                value = cge_negotiation_queue^0
            }
            remove_from_array = {
                array = cge_negotiation_queue
                index = 0
            }
            clear_array = cge_negotiation_origin
            clear_array = cge_negotiation_partner
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    add_to_array = {
                        array = cge_negotiation_origin
                        value = cge_negotiation_[GROUP]_origin^0
                    }
                    add_to_array = {
                        array = cge_negotiation_partner
                        value = cge_negotiation_[GROUP]_partner^0
                    }
                }
                GROUP = "[?cge_negotiation_active_group|.0]"
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_negotiation_stage = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_recovery_active
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_recovery_queue^num
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_negotiation_waiting_for_recovery
            }
            else = {
                cge_negotiation_refresh_terms = yes
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_terms_valid
                    }
                    country_event = {
                        id = cge_negotiations.1
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    cge_negotiation_finish = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_negotiation_resume_after_recovery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
            has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_waiting_for_recovery
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = cge_negotiation_active_group
                NOT = {
                    OR = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_recovery_active
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_recovery_queue^num
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_negotiation_waiting_for_recovery
            cge_negotiation_refresh_terms = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_terms_valid
                }
                country_event = {
                    id = cge_negotiations.1
                }
            }
            else = {
                cge_negotiation_finish = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = cge_negotiation_active_group
                }
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_negotiation_waiting_for_recovery
            cge_negotiation_schedule_next = yes
        }
    }
}
cge_negotiation_refresh_terms = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_captor
        clr_country_flag = cge_negotiation_terms_valid
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_general_count = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_highest_level = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_claim_strength = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_reparations_percent = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_reparations_payer_percent = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_negotiation_acceptance_percent = 25
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_highest_level = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_claim_strength = 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = cge_negotiation_active_group
            }
            var:cge_negotiation_origin^0 = {
                save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_origin_country
            }
            event_target:cge_negotiation_origin_country = {
                save_event_target_as = cge_return_origin
            }
            cge_negotiation_resolve_partner = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                    event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                        NOT = {
                            tag = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                        }
                    }
                }
                clear_array = cge_negotiation_partner
                add_to_array = {
                    array = cge_negotiation_partner
                    value = event_target:cge_return_destination
                }
                event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                    save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_partner_country
                    save_event_target_as = cge_reparations_payer
                }
                for_loop_effect = {
                    start = 1
                    end = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                    value = cge_negotiation_terms_slot
                    meta_effect = {
                        text = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_group
                                        value = cge_negotiation_active_group
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                add_to_variable = {
                                    cge_negotiation_general_count = 1
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                                    value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_level
                                }
                                cge_reparations_add_claim_value = yes
                            }
                        }
                        SLOT = "[?cge_negotiation_terms_slot|.0]"
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_general_count
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                    cge_reparations_finalize_claim = yes
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_negotiation_highest_level
                        value = cge_reparations_highest_level
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_negotiation_claim_strength
                        value = cge_reparations_claim_strength
                    }
                    cge_reparations_calculate_terms = yes
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_negotiation_reparations_percent
                        value = cge_reparations_receiver_percent
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_negotiation_reparations_payer_percent
                        value = cge_reparations_payer_percent
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            event_target:cge_negotiation_partner_country = {
                                is_subject_of = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                            }
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_negotiation_highest_level
                                value = 3
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_negotiation_acceptance_percent = 100
                    }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_highest_level
                            value = 3
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_negotiation_acceptance_percent = 75
                    }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_highest_level
                            value = 2
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_negotiation_acceptance_percent = 50
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_general_count
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            any_enemy_country = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = original_tag
                                    value = event_target:cge_negotiation_origin_country.original_tag
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_country_flag = cge_negotiation_terms_valid
                }
            }
        }
        cge_reparations_clear_calculation = yes
    }
}

cge_negotiation_receive_response = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_negotiation_stage
                    value = 2
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            cge_negotiation_refresh_terms = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_terms_valid
                }
                clr_country_flag = cge_negotiation_reparations_accepted
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_acceptance_percent
                            value = 100
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    set_country_flag = cge_negotiation_reparations_accepted
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_acceptance_percent
                            value = 75
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    random_list = {
                        75 = {
                            set_country_flag = cge_negotiation_reparations_accepted
                        }
                        25 = {
                        }
                    }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_negotiation_acceptance_percent
                            value = 50
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    random_list = {
                        50 = {
                            set_country_flag = cge_negotiation_reparations_accepted
                        }
                        50 = {
                        }
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    random_list = {
                        25 = {
                            set_country_flag = cge_negotiation_reparations_accepted
                        }
                        75 = {
                        }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_reparations_accepted
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_negotiation_stage = 4
                    }
                    country_event = {
                        id = cge_negotiations.2
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_negotiation_stage = 3
                    }
                    country_event = {
                        id = cge_negotiations.3
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                cge_negotiation_finish = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

    }
