cge_negotiation_refuse_return = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_negotiation_refresh_terms = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_terms_valid
            }
            event_target:cge_negotiation_partner_country = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        is_subject_of = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                    }
                    add_opinion_modifier = {
                        target = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                        modifier = cge_subject_generals_detained
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    add_opinion_modifier = {
                        target = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                        modifier = cge_generals_detained
                    }
                    send_embargo = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor
                }
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = cge_captured_general_count
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_negotiation_refusal_slot
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_group
                                    value = cge_negotiation_active_group
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            multiply_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_patience = 0.5
                            }
                            multiply_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_cooperation = 0.5
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_refused = 1
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_state = 2
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot = [SLOT]
                            }
                            cge_mirror_slot_to_character = yes
                        }
                    }
                    SLOT = "[?cge_negotiation_refusal_slot|.0]"
                }
            }
            cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
        }
        cge_negotiation_finish = yes
    }
}
cge_negotiation_release_active = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_captor
        clear_array = cge_general_display_characters
        clr_country_flag = cge_show_overview_window
        set_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
        set_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = cge_captured_general_count
            end = 1
            add = -1
            compare = greater_than_or_equals
            value = cge_negotiation_release_slot
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_group
                                value = cge_negotiation_active_group
                                compare = equals
                            }
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_negotiation_work_slot = [SLOT]
                        }
                        cge_negotiation_hold_slot = yes
                        var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_returning_general
                        }
                        event_target:cge_negotiation_returning_general = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_return_role_character
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_return_role_slot = [SLOT]
                        }
                        cge_return_stage_role_from_slot = yes
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_release_slot_to_remove = [SLOT]
                        }
                        cge_release_remove_selected_slot = yes
                        event_target:cge_negotiation_returning_general = {
                            cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_cge_slot_index = 0
                            }
                            set_character_flag = cge_roster_retired
                            if = {
                                limit = { is_general_captured = yes }
                                release_from_captivity = yes
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    event_target:cge_negotiation_partner_country = {
                                        NOT = {
                                            has_character = event_target:cge_negotiation_returning_general
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                set_nationality = event_target:cge_negotiation_partner_country
                            }
                            clear_variable = cge_native_captor
                            cge_return_force_unrestricted_transferred_role = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_negotiation_release_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
        clr_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
        cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
    }
}
cge_negotiation_finish = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = cge_negotiation_active_group
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = cge_captured_general_count
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_negotiation_finish_slot
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_group
                                    value = cge_negotiation_active_group
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_state = 2
                            }
                            clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_group
                            clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_pending
                            clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_ready
                        }
                    }
                    SLOT = "[?cge_negotiation_finish_slot|.0]"
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    clear_array = cge_negotiation_[GROUP]_origin
                    clear_array = cge_negotiation_[GROUP]_partner
                }
                GROUP = "[?cge_negotiation_active_group|.0]"
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_negotiation_waiting_for_recovery
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_active_group
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_stage
        clear_array = cge_negotiation_origin
        clear_array = cge_negotiation_partner
        clr_country_flag = cge_negotiation_terms_valid
        clr_country_flag = cge_negotiation_reparations_accepted
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_general_count
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_highest_level
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_claim_strength
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_reparations_percent
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_reparations_payer_percent
        clear_variable = cge_negotiation_acceptance_percent
        cge_negotiation_schedule_next = yes
    }
}

cge_pay_patience_cost = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_overview_patience_selected_action
                    value = 1
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            add_political_power = -50
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_overview_patience_selected_action
                    value = 2
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            add_command_power = -10
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_overview_patience_selected_action
                    value = 3
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            add_political_power = -100
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_overview_patience_selected_action
                    value = 5
                    compare = equals

cge_history_clear_view = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_overview_history_count = 0
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = 16
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_history_row
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_date = 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_operation = 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_variant = 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_patience_dir = 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_patience_abs = 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_cooperation_dir = 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_cooperation_abs = 0
                    }
                }
                CGE_H = "[?cge_history_row|.0]"
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_history_row
    }
}
cge_history_load = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_history_clear_view = yes
        set_variable = {
            cge_history_present = 0
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_count
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_history_present = 1
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_overview_history_count
                        value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_count
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot_ctx|.0]"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_history_present
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = 16
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_history_row
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_date
                            value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_[CGE_H]_date
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_operation
                            value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_[CGE_H]_operation
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_variant
                            value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_[CGE_H]_variant
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_patience_dir
                            value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_[CGE_H]_patience_dir
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_patience_abs
                            value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_[CGE_H]_patience_abs
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_cooperation_dir
                            value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_[CGE_H]_cooperation_dir
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_history_[CGE_H]_cooperation_abs
                            value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_[CGE_H]_cooperation_abs
                        }
                    }
                    CGE_H = "[?cge_history_row|.0]"
                    CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot_ctx|.0]"
                }
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_history_present
        clear_variable = cge_history_row
    }
}

cge_select_cooperation_op = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_selected_slot
                            value = [CGE_SLOT]
                            compare = equals
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_timer_running
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_cooperation_selected_action
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_selected_action = var:cge_overview_cooperation_selected_action
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_operation_pending = 1
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_overview_selected_slot|.0]"
        }
    }
}
cge_pay_cooperation_cost = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_overview_cooperation_selected_action
                    value = 1
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            add_political_power = -50
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_overview_cooperation_selected_action
                    value = 4
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            add_command_power = -10
        }
    }
}

cge_execute_selected_general = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                save_event_target_as = cge_execution_captor
                var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                    release_from_captivity = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_character_key
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                        has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country
                    }
                    var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_execution_static_id
                            value = event_target:cge_execution_captor.cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_character_key
                        }
                        remove_unit_leader = var:cge_execution_static_id
                        clear_variable = cge_execution_static_id
                    }
                }
                var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                    retire = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_execution_date
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_execution_date
                        value = global.date
                    }
                }
                clear_array = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_captor_country_display
                cge_refresh_list_state = yes
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot_ctx|.0]"
        }
    }
}

                                    }
                                }

                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_timer_days_left = 30
                        }

cge_load_patience_op = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_selected_slot
                            value = [CGE_SLOT]
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_timer_running
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_overview_patience_selected_action = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_operation_pending = 1
                            }
                        }
                        else = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_overview_patience_selected_action
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action = var:cge_overview_patience_selected_action
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_operation_pending = 1
                                }
                            }
                            else = {
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_overview_patience_selected_action = 0
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_patience_selected_action = 0
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_overview_selected_slot|.0]"
        }
    }

cge_trial_finish_condemn = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_operation_pending
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action
                            value = 5
                            compare = equals
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruited
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_stage
                            value = 14
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_pre_patience
                        value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_pre_cooperation
                        value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_history_branch_variant = 11
                    }
                    subtract_from_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience = 15
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_condemned = 1
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_route
                                value = 1
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_route
                                value = 2
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_route
                                value = 1
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_severity
                                    value = 101
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            add_war_support = 0.10
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_severity
                                    value = 102
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            add_war_support = 0.075
                            add_stability = 0.05
                        }
                        else = {
                            add_war_support = 0.075
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_route
                                value = 2
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_severity
                                    value = 201
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            add_war_support = 0.05
                            add_command_power = 50
                            army_experience = 20
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_severity
                                    value = 202
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            add_stability = 0.075
                            add_command_power = 30
                            army_experience = 15
                        }
                        else = {
                            add_command_power = 30
                            army_experience = 15
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_trial_route
                                value = 3
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        add_war_support = 0.05
                    }

                            }

                            }

cge_resolve_ranked_threaten = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_threaten_level
                    value = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_level
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_threaten_level
                            value = 1
                            compare = less_than
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_threaten_level = 1
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_threaten_level
                            value = 6
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_threaten_level = 6
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_threaten_success
                    value = cge_threaten_level
                }
                multiply_variable = {
                    cge_threaten_success = -10
                }
                add_to_variable = {
                    cge_threaten_success = 90
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_rank_key
                            value = 2
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    subtract_from_variable = {
                        cge_threaten_success = 20
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_threaten_failure = 100
                }
                subtract_from_variable = {
                    var = cge_threaten_failure
                    value = cge_threaten_success
                }
                cge_roll_ranked_threaten = yes
                clear_variable = cge_threaten_level
                clear_variable = cge_threaten_success
                clear_variable = cge_threaten_failure
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_daily_slot|.0]"
        }
    }

cge_recruit_slot_general = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_recruitment_captor
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                    }
                    var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                        save_event_target_as = cge_recruited_general

                            save_event_target_as = cge_recruitment_origin
                        }
                    }
                    event_target:cge_recruitment_origin = {
                        set_nationality = {
                            target_country = event_target:cge_recruitment_captor
                            character = event_target:cge_recruited_general
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            event_target:cge_recruited_general = {
                                OWNER = {
                                    tag = event_target:cge_recruitment_captor
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_recruited_general = {
                            release_from_captivity = yes
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        event_target:cge_recruited_general = {
                            release_from_captivity = yes
                        }
                        event_target:cge_recruitment_origin = {
                            set_nationality = {
                                target_country = event_target:cge_recruitment_captor
                                character = event_target:cge_recruited_general
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_recruited_general = {
                            release_from_captivity = yes
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            event_target:cge_recruited_general = {
                                OWNER = {
                                    tag = event_target:cge_recruitment_captor
                                }
                                is_general_captured = no
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_recruited_general = {
                            clr_character_flag = cge_captured_by_player
                            clr_character_flag = cge_bribed_by_player
                            set_character_flag = cge_recruited_by_player
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruited = 1
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruitment_date
                            value = global.date
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience = 100
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_held_state = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_timer_running = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_timer_progress = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_timer_days_left = 30
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_operation_pending = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_status_refresh_pending = 1
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot = [CGE_SLOT]
                        }
                        cge_mirror_slot_to_character = yes
                        clear_variable = cge_slot
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = {
                                    is_leader_visible = event_target:cge_recruited_general
                                }
                            }
                        }

                    }
                }

                }
            }

cge_pow_add_digit = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = 9
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_pow_digit_iteration
            set_temp_variable = {
                var = cge_pow_test_thousands
                value = cge_pow_inflicted_thousands
            }
            add_to_temp_variable = {
                var = cge_pow_test_thousands
                value = cge_pow_digit_step
            }
            subtract_from_temp_variable = {
                cge_pow_test_thousands = 0.001
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    casualties_inflicted_by = {
                        opponent = event_target:cge_pow_captor
                        thousands > cge_pow_test_thousands
                    }
                }
                add_to_temp_variable = {
                    var = cge_pow_inflicted_thousands
                    value = cge_pow_digit_step
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                PREV = {
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_cache_suicide
                        value = PREV.cge_cge_suicide
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_calc_timer_frame = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_timer_frame_work
            value = cge_timer_duration_work
        }
        subtract_from_variable = {
            var = cge_timer_frame_work
            value = cge_timer_days_left_work
        }
        multiply_variable = {
            cge_timer_frame_work = 30
        }
        divide_variable = {
            var = cge_timer_frame_work
            value = cge_timer_duration_work
        }
        subtract_from_variable = {
            cge_timer_frame_work = 0.499
        }
        round_variable = cge_timer_frame_work
        multiply_variable = {
            cge_timer_frame_work = 100
        }
        divide_variable = {
            cge_timer_frame_work = 30
        }
        subtract_from_variable = {
            cge_timer_frame_work = 0.499
        }
        round_variable = cge_timer_frame_work
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_timer_days_left_work
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_timer_frame_work = 0
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_update_timer_frames = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_overview_patience_timer_progress = 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_overview_patience_timer_running
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_timer_days_left_work
                value = cge_overview_patience_timer_days_left
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_timer_duration_work = 30
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    cge_patience_70_days = yes
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_timer_duration_work = 70
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    cge_patience_140_days = yes
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_timer_duration_work = 140
                }
            }
            cge_calc_timer_frame = yes
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_overview_patience_timer_progress
                value = cge_timer_frame_work
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_overview_cooperation_timer_progress = 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_overview_cooperation_timer_running
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_timer_days_left_work
                value = cge_overview_cooperation_timer_days_left
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_timer_duration_work = 30
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    cge_cooperation_70_days = yes
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_timer_duration_work = 70
                }
            }
            cge_calc_timer_frame = yes
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_overview_cooperation_timer_progress
                value = cge_timer_frame_work
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_timer_days_left_work
        clear_variable = cge_timer_duration_work
        clear_variable = cge_timer_frame_work
    }
}

cge_assign_owner_portrait = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = cge_runtime_portrait_key
                }
            }
            cge_assign_compat_generic_portrait = yes
        }
    }
}

            limit = {
                is_female = yes
            }
            cge_assign_female_portrait = yes
        }
        else = {
            cge_assign_runtime_portrait_male_pool = yes
        }
    }
}

# ===== cge_postwar_effects.txt =====
cge_postwar_prepare_event = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_array = cge_postwar_general_display
        clear_array = cge_postwar_origin_display
        clear_array = cge_postwar_destination_display
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_event_target = cge_postwar_general
            }
            add_to_array = {
                array = cge_postwar_general_display
                value = event_target:cge_postwar_general
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_postwar_general_display^num
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_postwar_selected_slot
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_postwar_selected_slot
                    value = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                        }
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_postwar_general_display
                            value = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_postwar_selected_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_postwar_general_display^num
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_captured_general_count
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            set_temp_variable = {
                cge_postwar_event_fallback_slot = 1
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                        }
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_postwar_general_display
                            value = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_postwar_event_fallback_slot|.0]"
            }
            clear_variable = cge_postwar_event_fallback_slot
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_postwar_origin_display^num
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                has_event_target = cge_postwar_origin
            }
            add_to_array = {
                array = cge_postwar_origin_display
                value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_postwar_origin_display^num
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_postwar_selected_slot
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_postwar_selected_slot
                    value = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_postwar_event_origin_display
                        }
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_postwar_origin_display
                            value = event_target:cge_postwar_event_origin_display
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_postwar_selected_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_postwar_origin_display^num
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_captured_general_count
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            set_temp_variable = {
                cge_postwar_event_fallback_slot = 1
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_postwar_event_origin_display
                        }
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_postwar_origin_display
                            value = event_target:cge_postwar_event_origin_display
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_postwar_event_fallback_slot|.0]"
            }
            clear_variable = cge_postwar_event_fallback_slot
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_postwar_destination_display^num
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                has_event_target = cge_postwar_destination
            }
            add_to_array = {
                array = cge_postwar_destination_display
                value = event_target:cge_postwar_destination
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_postwar_begin_origin = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_deferred_gate_origin = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_deferred_skip_origin
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_deferred_skip_origin
            cge_postwar_finish_origin_core = yes
        }
        else = {
            cge_postwar_resolve_destination = yes
            cge_postwar_begin_origin_core = yes
        }
    }
}
cge_postwar_begin_origin_core = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_array = cge_postwar_origin_display
        add_to_array = {
            array = cge_postwar_origin_display
            value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
        }
        event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_ready
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = yes
                    is_subject_of = ROOT
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_ready
            }
        }
        cge_postwar_mark_origin_family = yes
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_repatriated_any
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_waiting_for_general_decision
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_not_first_page
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_has_more
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_selected_slot
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_governor_cursor
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_candidate_slot_1
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_candidate_slot_2
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_candidate_slot_3
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_general
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_candidate_1
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_candidate_2
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_candidate_3
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_slot_iter
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_slot_arg
                value = cge_slot_iter
            }
            cge_slot_clear_postwar_flag = yes
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = original_tag
                                    value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin.original_tag
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            clr_character_flag = cge_postwar_war_pending
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot_arg|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_enemy_country = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = original_tag
                        value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin.original_tag
                        compare = equals
                    }
                }
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_considered
            cge_postwar_finish_origin = yes
        }
        else = {
            cge_postwar_repatriate = yes
            cge_postwar_continue_after_ordinary = yes
        }
    }
}
cge_postwar_finish_origin = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        var:cge_postwar_destination_display^0 = {
            save_global_event_target_as = cge_postwar_destination
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_is_subject
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_considered
                }
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_considered
            cge_postwar_offer_governor = yes
        }
        else = {
            cge_postwar_finish_origin_core = yes
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_found
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_is_subject
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_considered
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_ordinary_event_pending
            clear_array = cge_postwar_destination_display
            clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_destination
        }
    }
}
cge_postwar_finish_origin_core = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_array = cge_postwar_origin_display
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_has_governor_candidate
        every_possible_country = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_postwar_origin_match
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_current_origin
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_was_at_war_with_player
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_ready
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_slot_iter
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_slot_arg
                value = cge_slot_iter
            }
            cge_slot_clear_postwar_flag = yes
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_postwar_origin_match
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                clr_character_flag = cge_postwar_war_pending
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot_arg|.0]"
            }
        }
        every_possible_country = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_postwar_origin_match
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_origin_match
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_repatriated_any
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_waiting_for_general_decision
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_not_first_page
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_has_more
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_selected_slot
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_governor_cursor
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_candidate_slot_1
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_candidate_slot_2
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_candidate_slot_3
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_general
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_candidate_1
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_candidate_2
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_candidate_3
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_origin
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_postwar_origin_queue^num
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            country_event = {
                id = cge_postwar.1
                hours = 1
            }
        }
        else = {
            clear_array = cge_postwar_origin_queue
            clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_queue_active
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_postwar_watch_active
            }
            cge_postwar_schedule_event_scan = yes
        }
    }
}
cge_postwar_repatriate = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
            save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_offer_origin
        }
        cge_negotiation_prepare_offer = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_partner_found
                }
            }
            cge_postwar_repatriate_automatic = yes
        }
    }
}
cge_postwar_repatriate_automatic = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_ordinary_repatriated
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_repatriated_any
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_batch_pending_count = 0
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_repatriation_scan_index
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_pending
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_state
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = original_tag
                                    value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin.original_tag
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                NOT = {
                                    has_character_flag = cge_recruited_by_player
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    has_character_flag = cge_pow_recruitment_unlocked
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                any_enemy_country = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = original_tag
                                        value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin.original_tag
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_pending = 1
                        }
                        add_to_variable = {
                            cge_return_batch_pending_count = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_repatriation_scan_index|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_batch_pending_count
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_return_batch_kind = 1
            }
            clear_array = cge_return_batch_origin
            add_to_array = {
                array = cge_return_batch_origin
                value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
            }
            cge_return_begin_batch = yes
        }
        clear_variable = cge_return_batch_pending_count
    }
}
cge_postwar_scan_collaborators = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_postwar_waiting_for_general_decision
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_is_subject
                    NOT = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_considered
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_postwar_fate_phase_active
                    }
                }
                cge_postwar_offer_governor = yes
            }
            else = {
                cge_postwar_try_autonomy_request = yes
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_postwar_autonomy_request_fired
                        }
                    }
                    cge_postwar_scan_recruited_fates = yes
                }
                clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_autonomy_request_fired
            }
        }
        else = {
        }
    }
}
cge_postwar_try_autonomy_request = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
            NOT = {
                cge_deferred_mode_active = yes
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_autonomy_request_fired
        clear_array = cge_postwar_autonomy_candidates
        if = {
            limit = {
                event_target:cge_postwar_destination = {
                    NOT = {
                        exists = yes
                    }
                }
                any_owned_state = {
                    is_core_of = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
                    NOT = {
                        is_core_of = ROOT
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        is_claimed_by = ROOT
                    }
                }
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = cge_captured_general_count
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_slot_iter
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_slot_arg
                    value = cge_slot_iter
                }
                cge_slot_postwar_autonomy_candidate = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_postwar_autonomy_candidates^num
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                random_scope_in_array = {
                    array = cge_postwar_autonomy_candidates
                    save_global_event_target_as = cge_postwar_general
                    ROOT = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_postwar_selected_slot
                            value = event_target:cge_postwar_general.cge_cge_slot_index
                        }
                        set_country_flag = cge_postwar_waiting_for_general_decision
                        set_country_flag = cge_postwar_autonomy_request_fired
                        country_event = {
                            id = cge_postwar.4
                            hours = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        clear_array = cge_postwar_autonomy_candidates
    }
}

                }
                clear_array = cge_slot_[SLOT]_captor_country_display

                }
            }
            SLOT = "[?cge_postwar_selected_slot|.0]"
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_waiting_for_general_decision
        cge_postwar_refresh_list = yes
        cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
    }

cge_postwar_restore_origin_as_puppet = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        every_owned_state = {
            limit = {
                is_core_of = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
                OR = {
                    is_core_of = ROOT
                    is_claimed_by = ROOT
                }
            }
            remove_core_of = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
            set_state_flag = cge_postwar_restore_origin_core_after_release
        }
        release_puppet = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
        event_target:cge_postwar_origin = {
            save_global_event_target_as = cge_postwar_destination
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = yes
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_ready
            }
        }
        set_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_found
        set_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_is_subject
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_considered
        clear_array = cge_postwar_destination_display
        add_to_array = {
            array = cge_postwar_destination_display
            value = event_target:cge_postwar_destination
        }
        every_state = {
            limit = {
                has_state_flag = cge_postwar_restore_origin_core_after_release
            }
            add_core_of = event_target:cge_postwar_origin
            clr_state_flag = cge_postwar_restore_origin_core_after_release
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_waiting_for_general_decision
        cge_postwar_repatriate = yes
        cge_postwar_continue_after_ordinary = yes
    }
}

cge_postwar_build_governor_page = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_candidate_slot_1
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_candidate_slot_2
        clear_variable = cge_postwar_candidate_slot_3
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_candidate_1
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_candidate_2
        clear_global_event_target = cge_postwar_candidate_3
        clear_array = cge_postwar_candidate_1_display
        clear_array = cge_postwar_candidate_2_display
        clear_array = cge_postwar_candidate_3_display
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_has_more
        set_variable = {
            cge_page_found = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_slot
            value = cge_postwar_governor_cursor
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_slot = 1
        }
        while_loop_effect = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_slot
                    value = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_page_found
                    value = 3
                    compare = less_than
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_governor_match = 0
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = original_tag
                                    value = event_target:cge_postwar_origin.original_tag
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            OR = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                    has_character_flag = cge_recruited_by_player
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_governor_match = 1
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_page_found
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_postwar_candidate_slot_1 = [CGE_SLOT]
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                save_global_event_target_as = cge_postwar_candidate_1
                            }
                            add_to_array = {
                                array = cge_postwar_candidate_1_display
                                value = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_page_found
                                    value = 1
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_postwar_candidate_slot_2 = [CGE_SLOT]
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                save_global_event_target_as = cge_postwar_candidate_2
                            }
                            add_to_array = {
                                array = cge_postwar_candidate_2_display
                                value = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                        }
                        else = {
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_postwar_candidate_slot_3 = [CGE_SLOT]
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                save_global_event_target_as = cge_postwar_candidate_3
                            }
                            add_to_array = {
                                array = cge_postwar_candidate_3_display
                                value = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot|.0]"
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_governor_match
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_postwar_governor_cursor
                    value = cge_slot
                }
                add_to_variable = {
                    cge_page_found = 1
                }
            }
            add_to_variable = {
                cge_slot = 1
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_more_scan
            value = cge_postwar_governor_cursor
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_more_scan = 1
        }
        while_loop_effect = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_more_scan
                    value = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_has_more
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_slot_arg
                value = cge_more_scan
            }
            cge_slot_governor_probe = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_postwar_has_governor_candidate
                }
                set_country_flag = cge_postwar_governor_has_more
                clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_has_governor_candidate
            }
            add_to_variable = {

cge_pow_compliance_initialize = {
    if = {

            }
        }

                }
            }

            set_country_flag = cge_pow_compliance_initialized
            set_country_flag = cge_pow_compliance_migrating
            set_variable = {
                cge_pow_compliance_rows = 0
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = 10
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_pow_legacy_row
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        clear_array = cge_pow_legacy_[ROW]_origin
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_origin^num
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            add_to_array = {
                                array = cge_pow_legacy_[ROW]_origin
                                value = var:cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_origin^0
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_pow_legacy_[ROW]_stacks
                            value = cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_stacks
                        }
                        clear_array = cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_origin
                        clear_variable = cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_stacks
                        clear_variable = cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_gain
                    }
                    ROW = "[?cge_pow_legacy_row|.0]"
                }
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = 10
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_pow_legacy_row
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_pow_legacy_[ROW]_stacks
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
