                                value = cge_pow_legacy_[ROW]_stacks
                            }
                            cge_pow_compliance_register_origin = yes
                        }
                        clear_array = cge_pow_legacy_[ROW]_origin
                        clear_variable = cge_pow_legacy_[ROW]_stacks
                    }
                    ROW = "[?cge_pow_legacy_row|.0]"
                }
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_pow_compliance_counting_existing
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = cge_captured_general_count
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_pow_compliance_legacy_slot
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_pow_compliance_completion_slot
                    value = cge_pow_compliance_legacy_slot
                }
                cge_pow_compliance_register_slot = yes
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_pow_compliance_counting_existing
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = cge_pow_compliance_rows
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_pow_compliance_row
                meta_effect = {

    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {

                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^num

                            compare = greater_than

                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {

            clr_country_flag = cge_pow_compliance_active
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_idea = cge_pow_collaboration_network
                }
                remove_ideas = cge_pow_collaboration_network
            }
        }
        cge_pow_compliance_sync_states = yes
    }
}
cge_pow_compliance_daily_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_pow_compliance_refresh = yes
    }
}
cge_pow_compliance_sync_states = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_pow_compliance_captor
        every_state = {
            limit = {
                has_state_flag = cge_pow_compliance_managed_state
                var:cge_pow_compliance_beneficiary = {
                    tag = event_target:cge_pow_compliance_captor
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_pow_compliance_state_gain = 0
            }
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_pow_compliance_rows
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_pow_compliance_apply_index
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_stacks
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        every_controlled_state = {
                            limit = {
                                has_resistance = yes
                                OCCUPIED = {
                                    original_tag = var:PREV.PREV.cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_origin^0
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_pow_compliance_state_gain
                                value = PREV.cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_gain
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_pow_compliance_state_origin
                                value = var:PREV.cge_pow_compliance_[ROW]_origin^0
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_pow_compliance_beneficiary
                                value = event_target:cge_pow_compliance_captor
                            }
                            set_state_flag = cge_pow_compliance_managed_state
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        has_dynamic_modifier = {
                                            modifier = cge_pow_collaboration_growth
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                add_dynamic_modifier = {
                                    modifier = cge_pow_collaboration_growth
                                }
                            }
                            force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
                ROW = "[?cge_pow_compliance_apply_index|.0]"
            }
        }
        every_state = {
            limit = {
                has_state_flag = cge_pow_compliance_managed_state
                var:cge_pow_compliance_beneficiary = {
                    tag = event_target:cge_pow_compliance_captor
                }
                NOT = {
                    cge_pow_compliance_state_active = yes
                }
            }
            cge_pow_compliance_clear_state = yes
        }
    }
}
cge_pow_compliance_clear_state = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_dynamic_modifier = {
                    modifier = cge_pow_collaboration_growth
                }
            }
            remove_dynamic_modifier = {
                modifier = cge_pow_collaboration_growth
            }
        }
        clr_state_flag = cge_pow_compliance_managed_state
        clear_variable = cge_pow_compliance_state_gain
        clear_variable = cge_pow_compliance_state_origin
        clear_variable = cge_pow_compliance_beneficiary
    }
}

cge_pow_spawn_origin = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                ROOT = {
                    capital_scope = {
                        create_unit = {
                            division = "name = \"Foreign POW Division\" division_template = \"Foreign POW Division\" start_experience_factor = 0 start_equipment_factor = 0 start_manpower_factor = 1 force_equipment_variants = { infantry_equipment_0 = { owner = \"[CGE_ORIGIN]\" amount = [CGE_INF] } support_equipment_1 = { owner = \"[CGE_ORIGIN]\" amount = [CGE_SUP] } artillery_equipment_1 = { owner = \"[CGE_ORIGIN]\" amount = [CGE_ART] } }"
                            owner = ROOT
                            allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
                            count = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_ORIGIN = "[This.GetTag]"
            CGE_INF = "[?ROOT.cge_pow_free_infantry_equipment|.0]"
            CGE_SUP = "[?ROOT.cge_pow_free_support_equipment|.0]"
            CGE_ART = "[?ROOT.cge_pow_free_artillery_equipment|.0]"
        }
    }
}
cge_pow_spawn_selected = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = cge_overview_selected_slot
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_overview_selected_slot
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                            cge_pow_spawn_origin = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_overview_selected_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
    }
}

cge_pow_origin_derive_total_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_pow_total_thousands
            value = cge_pow_baseline25_highwater_thousands
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            var = cge_pow_total_thousands
            value = cge_pow_bonus_captured_thousands

            }
        }

            id = 990043
            disband = no
        }

                }
            }
        }

                }

                value = manpower_k
            }
            add_manpower = 1000000
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_pow_deployed_before_k
                value = deployed_army_manpower_k
            }
            cge_pow_probe_manpower = yes
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_pow_deployed_after_k
                value = deployed_army_manpower_k
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_pow_template_manpower_thousands
                value = cge_pow_deployed_after_k
            }
            subtract_from_variable = {
                var = cge_pow_template_manpower_thousands
                value = var:cge_pow_deployed_before_k
            }
            delete_unit = {
                id = 990043
                disband = no
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_pow_pool_restore_delta_k
                value = manpower_k
            }
            subtract_from_variable = {
                var = cge_pow_pool_restore_delta_k
                value = var:cge_pow_pool_before_k
            }
            multiply_variable = {
                var = cge_pow_pool_restore_delta_k
                value = -1000
            }
            add_manpower = var:cge_pow_pool_restore_delta_k
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_pow_template_manpower_thousands
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_pow_probe_state_found = 0
                }
            }
            clear_variable = cge_pow_pool_before_k
            clear_variable = cge_pow_deployed_before_k
            clear_variable = cge_pow_deployed_after_k
            clear_variable = cge_pow_pool_restore_delta_k
        }
    }

                            }

                        NOT = {

                        }
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {

                }
            }
            else = {

                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_pow_free_infantry_equipment
                    value = var:cge_pow_template_infantry_equipment_need
                }

                    var = cge_pow_free_support_equipment
                    value = 0.01
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_pow_free_artillery_equipment
                    value = var:cge_pow_template_artillery_equipment_need
                }
                multiply_variable = {
                    var = cge_pow_free_artillery_equipment
                    value = var:cge_overview_pow_capture_rate
                }
                multiply_variable = {
                    var = cge_pow_free_artillery_equipment
                    value = 0.01
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_pow_template_manpower_actual
                    value = cge_pow_template_manpower_thousands
                }
                multiply_variable = {
                    cge_pow_template_manpower_actual = 1000
                }
                add_manpower = var:cge_pow_template_manpower_actual
                save_event_target_as = cge_pow_equipment_captor
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = cge_overview_selected_slot
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_overview_selected_slot
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                    meta_effect = {
                        text = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {

                                }
                                var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {

                                    }

# ===== cge_recovery_effects.txt =====
cge_recovery_resolve_recipient = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_holder
        clr_country_flag = cge_recovery_recipient_found
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                    OWNER = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                exists = yes
                                NOT = {
                                    tag = event_target:cge_recovery_holder
                                }
                            }
                            save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_recipient
                            event_target:cge_recovery_holder = {
                                set_country_flag = cge_recovery_recipient_found
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                    save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_original_home
                }
                every_country = {
                    limit = {
                        is_ai = no
                        exists = yes
                        NOT = {
                            tag = event_target:cge_recovery_holder
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            has_war_with = event_target:cge_recovery_holder
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = original_tag
                            value = event_target:cge_recovery_original_home.original_tag
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_recipient
                    event_target:cge_recovery_holder = {
                        set_country_flag = cge_recovery_recipient_found
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_recovery_recipient_found
                        }
                    }
                    event_target:cge_recovery_original_home = {
                        save_event_target_as = cge_return_origin
                    }
                    cge_resolve_return_country = yes
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                        }
                        event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_recipient
                        }
                        set_country_flag = cge_recovery_recipient_found
                    }
                }
            }
            SLOT = "[?cge_recovery_offer_slot|.0]"
        }
    }
}
cge_recovery_offer_peacetime_prisoners = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_holder
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_recovery_offer_index
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_state
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                OR = {
                                    is_general_captured = yes
                                    AND = {
                                        has_global_flag = cge_custody_settlement_pending
                                        has_variable = cge_native_captor
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_native_captor
                                            value = PREV
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                OR = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        has_variable = cge_native_captor
                                    }
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_native_captor
                                        value = PREV
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_held_state = {
                                    CONTROLLER = {
                                        exists = yes
                                        NOT = {
                                            tag = event_target:cge_recovery_holder
                                        }
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = original_tag
                                            value = event_target:cge_recovery_holder.original_tag
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_recovery_offer_slot = [SLOT]
                        }
                        cge_recovery_resolve_recipient = yes
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_recovery_recipient_found
                                NOT = {
                                    has_war_with = event_target:cge_recovery_recipient
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    is_in_array = {
                                        array = cge_custody_victors
                                        value = event_target:cge_recovery_recipient
                                    }
                                }
                                event_target:cge_recovery_recipient = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        tag = event_target:cge_recovery_holder
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_recipient
                                value = event_target:cge_recovery_recipient
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_state = 1
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        NOT = {
                                            is_general_captured = yes
                                        }
                                    }
                                    capture_by = event_target:cge_recovery_holder
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    var = cge_native_captor
                                    value = event_target:cge_recovery_holder
                                }
                            }
                            event_target:cge_recovery_recipient = {
                                if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        NOT = {
                                            is_in_array = {
                                                array = cge_recovery_queue
                                                value = event_target:cge_recovery_holder
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    add_to_array = {
                                        array = cge_recovery_queue
                                        value = event_target:cge_recovery_holder
                                    }
                                }
                                cge_recovery_schedule_next = yes
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_recovery_offer_index|.0]"
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_recovery_schedule_next = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_recovery_queue^num
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_recovery_active
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_recovery_scheduled
                }
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_recovery_scheduled
            country_event = {
                id = cge_recovery.10
                hours = 1
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_recovery_begin_next = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_recovery_scheduled
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_recovery_active
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_recovery_queue^num
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_recovery_partner
                value = cge_recovery_queue^0
            }
            remove_from_array = {
                array = cge_recovery_queue
                index = 0
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_recovery_active
            cge_recovery_refresh_terms = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    cge_recovery_terms_valid = yes
                }
                country_event = {
                    id = cge_recovery.1
                }
            }
            else = {
                cge_recovery_finish = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_recovery_refresh_terms = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_client
        set_variable = {
            cge_recovery_count = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_recovery_exchange_count = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_recovery_price = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_recovery_receipts_percent = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_recovery_claim_strength = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_highest_level = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_claim_strength = 0
        }
        clear_array = cge_recovery_our_generals
        clear_array = cge_recovery_their_generals
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = cge_recovery_partner
            }
            var:cge_recovery_partner = {
                save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_partner_country
                for_loop_effect = {
                    start = 1
                    end = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                    value = cge_recovery_terms_index
                    meta_effect = {
                        text = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_state
                                        value = 1
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_recipient
                                        value = event_target:cge_recovery_client
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                        is_general_captured = yes
                                        OR = {
                                            NOT = { has_variable = cge_native_captor }
                                            check_variable = {
                                                var = cge_native_captor
                                                value = PREV
                                                compare = equals
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                event_target:cge_recovery_client = {
                                    add_to_variable = {
                                        cge_recovery_count = 1
                                    }
                                    set_variable = {
                                        var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                                        value = PREV.cge_slot_[SLOT]_level
                                    }
                                    cge_reparations_add_claim_value = yes
                                    add_to_array = {
                                        array = cge_recovery_our_generals
                                        value = PREV.cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        SLOT = "[?cge_recovery_terms_index|.0]"
                    }
                }
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = cge_captured_general_count
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_recovery_swap_index
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                    is_general_captured = yes
                                    OWNER = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = original_tag
                                            value = event_target:cge_recovery_partner_country.original_tag
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                    OR = {
                                        NOT = {
                                            has_variable = cge_native_captor
                                        }
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_native_captor
                                            value = PREV
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            add_to_variable = {
                                cge_recovery_exchange_count = 1
                            }
                            add_to_array = {
                                array = cge_recovery_their_generals
                                value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    SLOT = "[?cge_recovery_swap_index|.0]"
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_recovery_count
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                cge_reparations_finalize_claim = yes
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_recovery_claim_strength
                    value = cge_reparations_claim_strength
                }
                var:cge_recovery_partner = {
                    event_target:cge_recovery_client = {
                        save_event_target_as = cge_reparations_payer
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_reparations_claim_strength
                        value = event_target:cge_recovery_client.cge_recovery_claim_strength
                    }
                    cge_reparations_calculate_terms = yes
                    event_target:cge_recovery_client = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_recovery_receipts_percent
                            value = PREV.cge_reparations_receiver_percent
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_recovery_price
                            value = PREV.cge_reparations_payer_percent
                        }
                    }
                    cge_reparations_clear_calculation = yes
                }
            }
        }
        cge_reparations_clear_calculation = yes
    }
}
cge_recovery_remove_ours_from_partner_roster = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
            has_variable = cge_recovery_partner
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_cleanup_client
        var:cge_recovery_partner = {
            set_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
            set_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = cge_captured_general_count
                end = 1
                add = -1
                compare = greater_than_or_equals
                value = cge_recovery_cleanup_index
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_state
                                    value = 1
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_recipient
                                    value = event_target:cge_recovery_cleanup_client
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_release_slot_to_remove = [SLOT]
                            }
                            cge_release_remove_selected_slot = yes

                    }

        }
    }

cge_recovery_pay = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_recovery_refresh_terms = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                cge_recovery_terms_valid = yes
            }
            save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_partner_country
            var:cge_recovery_partner = {
                save_event_target_as = cge_negotiation_captor
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_negotiation_reparations_percent
                    value = event_target:cge_recovery_client.cge_recovery_receipts_percent
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_negotiation_reparations_payer_percent
                    value = event_target:cge_recovery_client.cge_recovery_price
                }
                cge_reparations_grant = yes
                clear_variable = cge_negotiation_reparations_percent
                clear_variable = cge_negotiation_reparations_payer_percent
            }
            cge_recovery_release_ours = yes
        }
        cge_recovery_finish = yes
    }
}
cge_recovery_exchange = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_recovery_refresh_terms = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                cge_recovery_terms_valid = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { check_variable = { var = cge_recovery_exchange_count value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
                cge_recovery_remove_theirs_from_client_roster = yes
                for_each_scope_loop = {
                    array = cge_recovery_their_generals
                    set_nationality = event_target:cge_recovery_partner_country
                    cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_cge_slot_index = 0
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            is_general_captured = yes
                        }
                        release_from_captivity = yes
                    }
                    clear_variable = cge_native_captor
                }
                cge_recovery_release_ours = yes
                cge_recovery_finish = yes
            }
            else = {
                country_event = { id = cge_recovery.1 }
            }
        }
        else = { cge_recovery_finish = yes }
    }
}
cge_recovery_release_ours = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_recovery_remove_ours_from_partner_roster = yes
        for_each_scope_loop = {
            array = cge_recovery_our_generals
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OWNER = {
                        NOT = {
                            tag = event_target:cge_recovery_client
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_nationality = event_target:cge_recovery_client
            }
            cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
            set_variable = {
                cge_cge_slot_index = 0
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    is_general_captured = yes
                }
                release_from_captivity = yes
            }
            clear_variable = cge_native_captor
        }
    }
}
cge_recovery_refuse = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        cge_recovery_refresh_terms = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                cge_recovery_terms_valid = yes
            }
            var:cge_recovery_partner = {
                for_loop_effect = {
                    start = 1
                    end = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                    value = cge_recovery_refusal_index
                    meta_effect = {
                        text = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_recipient
                                        value = event_target:cge_recovery_client
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_state = 2
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        SLOT = "[?cge_recovery_refusal_index|.0]"
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        cge_recovery_finish = yes
    }
}
cge_recovery_finish = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_recovery_client
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = cge_recovery_partner }
            var:cge_recovery_partner = {
                for_loop_effect = {
                    start = 1
                    end = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                    value = cge_recovery_close_index
                    meta_effect = {
                        text = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_state value = 1 compare = equals }
                                    check_variable = { var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_recipient value = event_target:cge_recovery_client compare = equals }
                                }
                                set_variable = { cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_state = 0 }
                                clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recovery_recipient
                            }
                        }
                        SLOT = "[?cge_recovery_close_index|.0]"
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_recovery_active
        clear_variable = cge_recovery_partner
        clear_array = cge_recovery_our_generals
        clear_array = cge_recovery_their_generals
        clear_variable = cge_recovery_count
        clear_variable = cge_recovery_exchange_count
        clear_variable = cge_recovery_claim_strength
        clear_variable = cge_recovery_receipts_percent
        clear_variable = cge_recovery_price
        cge_recovery_schedule_next = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_waiting_for_recovery
            }
            country_event = {
                id = cge_negotiations.12
                days = 1
            }
        }
    }
}

# ===== cge_reparations_effects.txt =====
cge_reparations_add_claim_value = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                value = 1
                compare = less_than
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_candidate_level = 1
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                value = cge_reparations_highest_level
                compare = greater_than
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_reparations_highest_level
            value = cge_reparations_candidate_level
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                value = 1
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_reparations_claim_strength = 2
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                value = 2
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_reparations_claim_strength = 3
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                value = 3
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_reparations_claim_strength = 4
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                value = 4
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_reparations_claim_strength = 6
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                value = 5
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_reparations_claim_strength = 8
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_candidate_level
                value = 6
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_reparations_claim_strength = 10
        }
    }
    else = {
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_reparations_claim_strength = 12
        }
    }
}

cge_reparations_calculate_terms = {
    set_variable = {
        var = cge_reparations_receiver_factories
        value = num_of_civilian_factories
    }
    add_to_variable = {
        var = cge_reparations_receiver_factories
        value = num_of_military_factories
    }
    event_target:cge_reparations_payer = {
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_reparations_factory_probe
            value = num_of_civilian_factories
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            var = cge_reparations_factory_probe
            value = num_of_military_factories
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        var = cge_reparations_payer_factories
        value = event_target:cge_reparations_payer.cge_reparations_factory_probe
    }
    event_target:cge_reparations_payer = {
        clear_variable = cge_reparations_factory_probe
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_payer_factories
                value = 5
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_economic_ceiling = 5
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_payer_factories
                value = 20
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_economic_ceiling = 10
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_payer_factories
                value = 50
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_economic_ceiling = 20
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_payer_factories
                value = 100
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_economic_ceiling = 30
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_payer_factories
                value = 175
                compare = less_than_or_equals
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_economic_ceiling = 35
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_economic_ceiling = 40
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        var = cge_reparations_receiver_percent
        value = cge_reparations_economic_ceiling
    }
    multiply_variable = {
        var = cge_reparations_receiver_percent
        value = cge_reparations_claim_strength
    }
    divide_variable = {
        cge_reparations_receiver_percent = 100
    }
    round_variable = cge_reparations_receiver_percent
    clamp_variable = {
        var = cge_reparations_receiver_percent
        min = 1
        max = 40
    }
    set_variable = {
        var = cge_reparations_payer_percent
        value = cge_reparations_receiver_percent
    }
    multiply_variable = {
        var = cge_reparations_payer_percent
        value = cge_reparations_receiver_factories
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_payer_factories
                value = 1
                compare = less_than
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_reparations_ratio_denominator = 1
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_reparations_ratio_denominator
            value = cge_reparations_payer_factories
        }
    }
    divide_variable = {
        var = cge_reparations_payer_percent
        value = cge_reparations_ratio_denominator
    }
    round_variable = cge_reparations_payer_percent
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_payer_percent
                value = cge_reparations_receiver_percent
                compare = less_than
            }
        }
        set_variable = {

        }
    }

        var = cge_reparations_payer_percent
        min = 1
        max = 60
    }
}

cge_reparations_record_receipt_display = {
    set_variable = {
        cge_reparations_display_slot = 0
    }
    for_loop_effect = {
        start = 1
        end = 20
        compare = less_than_or_equals
        value = cge_reparations_display_scan_slot
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_reparations_display_slot
                            value = 0
                            compare = equals
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_amount
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_reparations_display_slot = [SLOT]
                    }
                }
            }
            SLOT = "[?cge_reparations_display_scan_slot|.0]"
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_display_slot
                value = 0
                compare = greater_than
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_amount
                    value = cge_negotiation_reparations_percent
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_partner
                    value = event_target:cge_negotiation_partner_country
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_days = 170
                }
            }
            SLOT = "[?cge_reparations_display_slot|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = cge_reparations_display_slot
    clear_variable = cge_reparations_display_scan_slot
}

cge_reparations_refresh_payment_display = {
    for_loop_effect = {
        start = 1
        end = 20
        compare = less_than_or_equals
        value = cge_reparations_display_scan_slot
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_amount
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_display_amount
                        value = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_amount
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_reparations_payments_total
                                value = 60
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        multiply_variable = {
                            var = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_display_amount
                            value = 60
                        }
                        divide_variable = {
                            var = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_display_amount
                            value = cge_reparations_payments_total
                        }
                        round_variable = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_display_amount
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    clear_variable = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_display_amount
                }
            }
            SLOT = "[?cge_reparations_display_scan_slot|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = cge_reparations_display_scan_slot
}

cge_reparations_display_daily_tick = {
    for_loop_effect = {
        start = 1
        end = 20
        compare = less_than_or_equals
        value = cge_reparations_display_scan_slot
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_days
                    }
                    subtract_from_variable = {
                        cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_days = 1
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_days
                                value = 0
                                compare = less_than_or_equals
                            }
                        }
                        clear_variable = cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_amount
                        clear_variable = cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_partner
                        clear_variable = cge_reparations_receipt_[SLOT]_days
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_days
                    }
                    subtract_from_variable = {
                        cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_days = 1
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_days
                                value = 0
                                compare = less_than_or_equals
                            }
                        }
                        clear_variable = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_amount
                        clear_variable = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_display_amount
                        clear_variable = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_partner
                        clear_variable = cge_reparations_payment_[SLOT]_days
                    }
                }
            }
            SLOT = "[?cge_reparations_display_scan_slot|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = cge_reparations_display_scan_slot
    cge_reparations_refresh_receipts = yes
    cge_reparations_refresh_payments = yes
}

cge_reparations_grant = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        add_to_array = {
            array = cge_reparations_receipt_amounts
            value = cge_negotiation_reparations_percent
        }
        add_to_variable = {
            var = cge_reparations_receipts_total
            value = cge_negotiation_reparations_percent
        }
        cge_reparations_record_receipt_display = yes
        cge_reparations_refresh_receipts = yes
        add_dynamic_modifier = {
            modifier = cge_reparations_received
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_idea = cge_reparations_received_spirit } }
            add_ideas = cge_reparations_received_spirit
        }
        force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
        country_event = {
            id = cge_negotiations.20
            days = 170
        }
        event_target:cge_negotiation_partner_country = {
            add_to_array = {
                array = cge_reparations_payment_amounts
                value = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor.cge_negotiation_reparations_payer_percent
            }
            add_to_variable = {
                var = cge_reparations_payments_total
                value = event_target:cge_negotiation_captor.cge_negotiation_reparations_payer_percent
            }
            cge_reparations_record_payment_display = yes
            cge_reparations_refresh_payments = yes
            add_dynamic_modifier = {
                modifier = cge_reparations_paid
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_idea = cge_reparations_paid_spirit } }
                add_ideas = cge_reparations_paid_spirit
            }
            force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
            country_event = {
                id = cge_negotiations.21
                days = 170
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_reparations_refresh_receipts = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_reparations_received_factor
            value = cge_reparations_receipts_total
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_reparations_received_factor
                    value = 0
                    compare = less_than
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_reparations_received_factor = 0
            }
        }
        multiply_variable = {
            cge_reparations_received_factor = -0.01
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_reparations_receipts_total
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_dynamic_modifier = {
                        modifier = cge_reparations_received
                    }
                }
            }
            add_dynamic_modifier = {
                modifier = cge_reparations_received
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_reparations_receipts_total
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                NOT = { has_idea = cge_reparations_received_spirit }
            }
            add_ideas = cge_reparations_received_spirit
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_reparations_receipts_total
                    value = 0
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_dynamic_modifier = {
                        modifier = cge_reparations_received
                    }
                }
                remove_dynamic_modifier = {
                    modifier = cge_reparations_received
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_idea = cge_reparations_received_spirit }
                remove_ideas = cge_reparations_received_spirit
            }
            clear_variable = cge_reparations_receipts_total
            clear_variable = cge_reparations_received_factor
            clear_array = cge_reparations_receipt_amounts
            cge_reparations_clear_receipt_display = yes
        }
        force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
    }
}
cge_reparations_refresh_payments = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {

            value = cge_reparations_payments_total
        }
        clamp_variable = {
            var = cge_reparations_paid_factor
            min = 0
            max = 60
        }
        multiply_variable = {
            cge_reparations_paid_factor = 0.01
        }
        cge_reparations_refresh_payment_display = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_reparations_payments_total
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_dynamic_modifier = {
                        modifier = cge_reparations_paid
                    }
                }
            }
            add_dynamic_modifier = {
                modifier = cge_reparations_paid
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_reparations_payments_total
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                NOT = { has_idea = cge_reparations_paid_spirit }
            }
            add_ideas = cge_reparations_paid_spirit
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_reparations_payments_total
                    value = 0
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_dynamic_modifier = {
                        modifier = cge_reparations_paid
                    }
                }
                remove_dynamic_modifier = {
                    modifier = cge_reparations_paid
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_idea = cge_reparations_paid_spirit }
                remove_ideas = cge_reparations_paid_spirit

    }
}

# ===== cge_return_effects.txt =====
cge_resolve_return_country = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_return_captor
        clr_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
        clr_country_flag = cge_return_country_is_subject
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_best_score = -1
        }
        event_target:cge_return_origin = {
            save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
        }
        cge_return_follow_successors = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                }
            }
            event_target:cge_return_origin = {
                var:original_tag = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            any_owned_state = {
                                always = yes
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                has_war_with = event_target:cge_return_captor
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                tag = event_target:cge_return_captor
                            }
                        }
                        save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                        event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                            set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                }
            }
            every_country = {
                limit = {
                    any_owned_state = {
                        always = yes
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        has_war_with = event_target:cge_return_captor
                    }
                    check_variable = {
                        var = original_tag
                        value = event_target:cge_return_origin.original_tag
                        compare = equals
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_candidate_score
                    value = num_owned_states
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        is_subject_of = event_target:cge_return_captor
                    }
                    add_to_variable = {
                        cge_return_candidate_score = 10000
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_candidate_score
                            value = event_target:cge_return_captor.cge_return_best_score
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                    save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                    event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_best_score
                            value = PREV.cge_return_candidate_score
                        }
                        set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                    }
                }
                clear_variable = cge_return_candidate_score
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                }
            }
            every_country = {
                limit = {
                    is_subject_of = event_target:cge_return_captor
                    any_owned_state = {
                        is_core_of = event_target:cge_return_origin
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        has_war_with = event_target:cge_return_captor
                    }
                    event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                        }
                    }
                }
                save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                    set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                    is_subject_of = event_target:cge_return_captor
                }
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_return_country_is_subject
        }
        clear_variable = cge_return_best_score
    }
}
cge_return_bind_native_identity = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_array = cge_return_native_general
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_native_bound = 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_identity_key
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                every_army_leader = {
                    include_invisible = yes
                    limit = {
                        is_unit_leader = yes
                        OR = {
                            AND = {
                                has_variable = cge_cge_character_key
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_cge_character_key
                                    value = event_target:cge_return_captor.cge_return_identity_key
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            AND = {
                                has_variable = cge_registry_character_key
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_registry_character_key
                                    value = event_target:cge_return_captor.cge_return_identity_key
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    cge_return_bind_current_native = yes
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_return_native_bound
                        value = 0
                        compare = equals
                    }
                    OR = {
                        AND = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_identity_key
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_identity_key
                                value = 724
                                compare = less_than
                            }
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_identity_key
                            value = 725
                            compare = equals
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_identity_key
                            value = 9999
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                }
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                            cge_return_bind_native_key_[KEY] = yes
                        }
                    }
                    KEY = "[?cge_return_identity_key|.0]"
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
