            value = event_target:cge_return_destination
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_found
        clr_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_is_subject
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_found
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_return_country_is_subject
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_postwar_destination_is_subject
        }
    }
}
cge_return_begin_batch = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_return_captor
        cge_return_resolve_batch_destination = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_batch_kind
                    value = 1
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            cge_return_begin_ordinary_batch = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_batch_kind
                    value = 2
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            cge_return_begin_recruited_batch = yes
        }
        else = {
            cge_return_begin_ordinary_batch = yes
        }
    }
}
cge_return_prepare_ordinary_slot = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_slot_prepared = 0
        }
        clear_array = cge_return_native_general
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_native_bound = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_identity_key = 0
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                        OR = {
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_negotiation_state
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            has_country_flag = cge_negotiation_binding_custody
                        }
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_pending
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = original_tag
                                value = event_target:cge_return_origin.original_tag
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_civil_war_successor^num
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                exists = yes
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        is_unit_leader = yes
                                        is_general_captured = no
                                    }
                                    save_event_target_as = cge_return_role_character
                                    event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                                        set_variable = {
                                            cge_return_role_slot = [SLOT]
                                        }
                                        cge_return_stage_role_from_slot = yes
                                    }
                                    cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                    cge_return_unlock_if_hidden = yes
                                    event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                                        set_variable = {
                                            cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_ready = 1
                                        }
                                        set_variable = {
                                            cge_return_slot_prepared = 1
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_return_slot_prepared
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_character_key
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_identity_key
                                value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_character_key
                            }
                            cge_return_bind_native_identity = yes
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_return_native_bound
                                        value = 1
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                }
                                var:cge_return_native_general^0 = {
                                    if = {
                                        limit = {
                                            is_unit_leader = yes
                                            is_general_captured = no
                                        }
                                        save_event_target_as = cge_return_role_character
                                        event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                                            set_variable = {
                                                cge_return_role_slot = [SLOT]
                                            }
                                            cge_return_stage_role_from_slot = yes
                                        }
                                        cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                        cge_return_unlock_if_hidden = yes
                                        event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                                            set_variable = {
                                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_ready = 1
                                            }
                                            set_variable = {
                                                cge_return_slot_prepared = 1
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        is_unit_leader = yes
                                        is_general_captured = no
                                    }
                                    save_event_target_as = cge_return_role_character
                                    event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                                        set_variable = {
                                            cge_return_role_slot = [SLOT]
                                        }
                                        cge_return_stage_role_from_slot = yes
                                    }
                                    cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                    cge_return_unlock_if_hidden = yes
                                    event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                                        set_variable = {
                                            cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_ready = 1
                                        }
                                        set_variable = {
                                            cge_return_slot_prepared = 1
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            SLOT = "[?cge_return_work_slot|.0]"
        }
        clear_variable = cge_return_identity_key
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_native_bound = 0
        }
        clear_array = cge_return_native_general
    }

cge_return_begin_recruited_batch = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        event_target:cge_return_destination = {
            save_event_target_as = cge_return_recruited_default_destination
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_default_found
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
            }
            set_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_default_found
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_return_work_slot
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_pending
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        }
                        clr_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_target_found
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_civil_war_successor^num
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_civil_war_successor^0 = {
                                    exists = yes
                                    NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cge_return_captor }
                                    NOT = { tag = event_target:cge_return_captor }
                                }
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_civil_war_successor^0 = {
                                save_event_target_as = cge_return_recruited_target
                            }
                            set_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_target_found
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                            }
                            event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                                save_event_target_as = cge_return_recruited_target
                            }
                            set_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_target_found
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_target_found
                            }
                            event_target:cge_return_recruited_target = {
                                save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                            }
                            set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_identity_key
                                value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_character_key
                            }
                            cge_return_bind_native_identity = yes
                            clr_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_use_native
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_return_native_bound
                                        value = 1
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                                            value = cge_return_native_general^0
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                set_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_use_native
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_use_native
                                }
                                var:cge_return_native_general^0 = {
                                    save_event_target_as = cge_return_role_character
                                    save_event_target_as = cge_return_recruited_native_copy
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_return_role_slot = [SLOT]
                                }
                                cge_return_stage_role_from_slot = yes
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_return_native_scan = 1
                                }
                                while_loop_effect = {
                                    limit = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_return_native_scan
                                            value = cge_captured_general_count
                                            compare = less_than_or_equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                    meta_effect = {
                                        text = {
                                            if = {
                                                limit = {
                                                    has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[NSLOT]
                                                    has_variable = cge_slot_[NSLOT]_runtime_leader
                                                    check_variable = {
                                                        var = cge_slot_[NSLOT]_runtime_leader
                                                        value = event_target:cge_return_recruited_native_copy
                                                        compare = equals
                                                    }
                                                }
                                                set_variable = {
                                                    cge_slot_[NSLOT]_return_ready = 1
                                                }
                                                clear_variable = cge_slot_[NSLOT]_runtime_leader
                                            }
                                        }
                                        NSLOT = "[?cge_return_native_scan|.0]"
                                    }
                                    add_to_variable = {
                                        cge_return_native_scan = 1
                                    }
                                }
                                clear_variable = cge_return_native_scan
                                event_target:cge_return_recruited_native_copy = {
                                    cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                    clr_character_flag = cge_roster_retired
                                    clear_variable = cge_native_captor
                                    if = {
                                        limit = {
                                            is_general_captured = yes
                                        }
                                        release_from_captivity = yes
                                    }
                                    cge_return_force_unrestricted_transferred_role = yes
                                }
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                    cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                    clear_variable = cge_native_captor
                                    if = {
                                        limit = {
                                            is_general_captured = yes
                                        }
                                        release_from_captivity = yes
                                    }
                                    if = {
                                        limit = {
                                            is_unit_leader = yes
                                        }
                                        retire = yes
                                    }
                                }
                                clear_global_event_target = cge_return_recruited_native_copy
                            }
                            else = {
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                    save_event_target_as = cge_return_role_character
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_return_role_slot = [SLOT]
                                }
                                cge_return_stage_role_from_slot = yes
                                var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                    cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                    clear_variable = cge_native_captor
                                    if = {
                                        limit = {
                                            is_general_captured = yes
                                        }
                                        release_from_captivity = yes
                                    }
                                    set_nationality = event_target:cge_return_recruited_target
                                    cge_return_force_unrestricted_transferred_role = yes
                                }
                            }
                            clr_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_use_native
                            clear_array = cge_return_native_general
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_return_native_bound = 0
                            }
                            clr_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_default_found
                                }
                                set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                            }
                            event_target:cge_return_recruited_default_destination = {
                                save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_ready = 1
                            }
                            clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        }
                        else = {
                            clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_pending
                        }
                        clr_country_flag = cge_return_recruited_target_found
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_return_work_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
        cge_return_remove_ready_slots = yes
        cge_return_finish_batch = yes
    }

cge_return_remove_ready_slots = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
        set_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_return_remove_index
            value = cge_captured_general_count
        }
        while_loop_effect = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_remove_index
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_return_slot_is_ready = 0
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_ready
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_return_slot_is_ready = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_return_remove_index|.0]"
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_return_slot_is_ready
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_release_slot_to_remove
                    value = cge_return_remove_index
                }
                cge_release_remove_selected_slot = yes
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_batch_kind
                            value = 1
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    set_country_flag = cge_postwar_ordinary_repatriated
                    set_country_flag = cge_postwar_repatriated_any
                }
            }
            subtract_from_variable = {
                cge_return_remove_index = 1
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
        clr_country_flag = cge_roster_batch_removal
        clear_variable = cge_return_slot_is_ready
        clear_variable = cge_return_remove_index
        cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
    }
}

cge_return_follow_successors = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_return_captor
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_return_path_country
            value = event_target:cge_return_origin
        }
        clear_array = cge_return_visited_countries
        set_country_flag = cge_return_follow_next
        while_loop_effect = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_return_follow_next
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_return_follow_next
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        is_in_array = {
                            array = cge_return_visited_countries
                            value = var:cge_return_path_country
                        }
                    }
                }
                add_to_array = {
                    array = cge_return_visited_countries
                    value = var:cge_return_path_country
                }
                var:cge_return_path_country = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_civil_war_successor^num
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_return_civil_war_successor^0 = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_return_link_successor
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    any_owned_state = {
                                        always = yes
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        has_war_with = event_target:cge_return_captor
                                    }
                                }
                                save_event_target_as = cge_return_destination
                                event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                                    set_country_flag = cge_return_country_found
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_return_captor = {
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_path_country
                                value = event_target:cge_return_link_successor
                            }
                            set_country_flag = cge_return_follow_next
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_return_path_country
        clear_array = cge_return_visited_countries
    }
}

cge_return_reconcile_dead_origins = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_captured_general_count
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            save_event_target_as = cge_return_captor
            clr_country_flag = cge_return_dead_repatriated_any
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_return_dead_scan_slot
                value = cge_captured_general_count
            }
            while_loop_effect = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_return_dead_scan_slot
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                cge_return_prepare_dead_reconcile_slot = yes
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_dead_slot_ready
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_dead_character_action
                                value = 3
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_return_dead_winner_character = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_return_role_character
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_role_slot
                            value = cge_return_dead_scan_slot
                        }
                        cge_return_stage_role_from_slot = yes
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_dead_character_action
                                value = 2
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_return_dead_character = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_return_role_character
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_return_role_slot
                            value = cge_return_dead_scan_slot
                        }
                        cge_return_stage_role_from_slot = yes
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_release_slot_to_remove
                        value = cge_return_dead_scan_slot
                    }
                    set_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
                    cge_release_remove_selected_slot = yes
                    clr_country_flag = cge_return_metadata_only_cleanup
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_dead_character_action
                                value = 3
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_return_dead_loser_found
                                    value = 1
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            event_target:cge_return_dead_loser_character = {
                                cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                retire = yes
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_return_dead_winner_character = {
                            cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    is_general_captured = yes
                                }
                                release_from_captivity = yes
                            }
                            cge_return_force_unrestricted_transferred_role = yes
                        }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_dead_character_action
                                value = 2
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_return_dead_character = {
                            cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                            set_nationality = event_target:cge_return_dead_successor
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    is_general_captured = yes
                                }
                                release_from_captivity = yes
                            }
                            cge_return_force_unrestricted_transferred_role = yes
                        }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_return_dead_character_action
                                value = 1
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        event_target:cge_return_dead_character = {
                            cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    is_general_captured = yes
                                }
                                release_from_captivity = yes
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_country_flag = cge_return_dead_repatriated_any
                }
                subtract_from_variable = {
                    cge_return_dead_scan_slot = 1
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_return_dead_repatriated_any
                }
                country_event = {
                    id = cge_postwar.2
                    hours = 1
                }
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_return_dead_repatriated_any
            clear_variable = cge_return_dead_scan_slot
            clear_variable = cge_return_dead_slot_ready
            clear_variable = cge_return_dead_character_action
            clear_variable = cge_return_dead_winner_found
            clear_variable = cge_return_dead_loser_found
            clear_variable = cge_return_dead_slot_qualifies
        }
    }
}
cge_return_retry_pending = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = cge_return_batch_kind
                }
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_return_recovery_origin_found
            set_variable = {
                cge_return_recovery_slot = 1
            }
            while_loop_effect = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_return_recovery_slot
                        value = cge_captured_general_count
                        compare = less_than_or_equals
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_return_recovery_origin_found
                    }
                }
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_return_pending
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^num
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                save_event_target_as = cge_return_recovery_origin
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        any_enemy_country = {
                                            check_variable = {
                                                var = original_tag
                                                value = event_target:cge_return_recovery_origin.original_tag
                                                compare = equals
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                set_country_flag = cge_return_recovery_origin_found
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    SLOT = "[?cge_return_recovery_slot|.0]"
                }
                add_to_variable = {
                    cge_return_recovery_slot = 1
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_return_recovery_origin_found
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_return_batch_kind = 1
                }
                clear_array = cge_return_batch_origin
                add_to_array = {
                    array = cge_return_batch_origin
                    value = event_target:cge_return_recovery_origin
                }
                cge_return_begin_batch = yes
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_return_recovery_origin_found
            clear_variable = cge_return_recovery_slot
            clear_global_event_target = cge_return_recovery_origin
        }
    }
}

cge_return_refresh_saved_role_stats_from_live = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
            is_unit_leader = yes
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_return_saved_rank = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                is_field_marshal = yes
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_return_saved_rank = 2
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_return_saved_level
            value = skill_level
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_return_saved_attack
            value = attack_skill_level
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_return_saved_defense
            value = defense_skill_level
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_return_saved_planning
            value = planning_skill_level
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_return_saved_logistics
            value = logistics_skill_level
        }
    }
}

cge_return_unlock_if_hidden = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_return_visibility_character
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    is_unit_leader = yes
                }
            }
            cge_return_rebuild_unrestricted_role = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                has_event_target = cge_return_destination
                event_target:cge_return_destination = {
                    NOT = {
                        is_leader_visible = event_target:cge_return_visibility_character
                    }
                }
            }
            cge_return_refresh_saved_role_stats_from_live = yes
            cge_return_rebuild_unrestricted_role = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                has_event_target = cge_negotiation_partner_country
                event_target:cge_negotiation_partner_country = {
                    NOT = {
                        is_leader_visible = event_target:cge_return_visibility_character
                    }
                }
            }
            cge_return_refresh_saved_role_stats_from_live = yes
            cge_return_rebuild_unrestricted_role = yes
        }
        cge_return_clear_saved_role = yes
    }
}

cge_return_force_unrestricted_transferred_role = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        set_character_flag = cge_postwar_force_visible
        cge_return_unlock_if_hidden = yes
    }
}

cge_return_clear_saved_role = {
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_rank
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_level
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_attack
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_defense
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_planning
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_logistics
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_trait_1
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_trait_2
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_trait_3
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_trait_4
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_trait_5
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_trait_6
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_trait_7
    clear_variable = cge_return_saved_trait_8
}
cge_return_rebuild_unrestricted_role = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_return_saved_level value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
            }
            set_variable = { cge_return_saved_level = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_return_saved_attack value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
            }
            set_variable = { cge_return_saved_attack = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_return_saved_defense value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
            }
            set_variable = { cge_return_saved_defense = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_return_saved_planning value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
            }
            set_variable = { cge_return_saved_planning = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_return_saved_logistics value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
            }
            set_variable = { cge_return_saved_logistics = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                is_unit_leader = yes
            }
            remove_unit_leader_role = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_saved_rank
                    value = 2
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    add_field_marshal_role = {
                        skill = [LVL]
                        attack_skill = [ATK]
                        defense_skill = [DEF]
                        planning_skill = [PLN]
                        logistics_skill = [LOG]
                        visible = {
                            always = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
                LVL = "[?cge_return_saved_level|.0]"
                ATK = "[?cge_return_saved_attack|.0]"
                DEF = "[?cge_return_saved_defense|.0]"
                PLN = "[?cge_return_saved_planning|.0]"
                LOG = "[?cge_return_saved_logistics|.0]"
            }
        }
        else = {
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    add_corps_commander_role = {
                        skill = [LVL]
                        attack_skill = [ATK]
                        defense_skill = [DEF]
                        planning_skill = [PLN]
                        logistics_skill = [LOG]
                        visible = {
                            always = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
                LVL = "[?cge_return_saved_level|.0]"
                ATK = "[?cge_return_saved_attack|.0]"
                DEF = "[?cge_return_saved_defense|.0]"
                PLN = "[?cge_return_saved_planning|.0]"
                LOG = "[?cge_return_saved_logistics|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_saved_trait_1
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    cge_return_add_trait_[TRAIT] = yes
                }
                TRAIT = "[?cge_return_saved_trait_1|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_saved_trait_2
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    cge_return_add_trait_[TRAIT] = yes
                }
                TRAIT = "[?cge_return_saved_trait_2|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_saved_trait_3
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    cge_return_add_trait_[TRAIT] = yes
                }
                TRAIT = "[?cge_return_saved_trait_3|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_saved_trait_4
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    cge_return_add_trait_[TRAIT] = yes
                }
                TRAIT = "[?cge_return_saved_trait_4|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_saved_trait_5
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    cge_return_add_trait_[TRAIT] = yes
                }
                TRAIT = "[?cge_return_saved_trait_5|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_saved_trait_6
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {

                }
                TRAIT = "[?cge_return_saved_trait_6|.0]"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_return_saved_trait_7
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    cge_return_add_trait_[TRAIT] = yes
                }
                TRAIT = "[?cge_return_saved_trait_7|.0]"

# ===== cge_risk_effects.txt =====
cge_risk_initialize_slot = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_type
                        }
                    }
                    random_list = {
                        90 = {
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_type = 0
                            }
                        }
                        5 = {
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_type = 1
                            }
                        }
                        5 = {
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_type = 2
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            SLOT = "[?cge_risk_slot|.0]"
        }
    }
}
cge_risk_observe_slot = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                is_ai = no
                NOT = {
                    has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
                }
            }
            cge_risk_initialize_slot = yes
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[SLOT]
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_type
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                is_general_captured = yes
                                NOT = {
                                    has_character_flag = cge_recruited_by_player
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    has_character_flag = cge_pow_recruitment_unlocked
                                }
                                OR = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        has_variable = cge_native_captor
                                    }
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_native_captor
                                        value = PREV
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            OR = {
                                AND = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_type
                                        value = 1
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_patience
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = less_than_or_equals
                                    }
                                }
                                AND = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_type
                                        value = 2
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_cooperation
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = less_than_or_equals
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = {
                                    has_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_zero_since
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_zero_since
                                value = global.num_days
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_risk_elapsed
                            value = global.num_days
                        }
                        subtract_from_variable = {
                            var = cge_risk_elapsed
                            value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_zero_since
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_risk_elapsed
                                    value = 100
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    has_country_flag = cge_risk_notice_pending
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    has_variable = cge_risk_ready_slot
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_risk_ready_slot = [SLOT]
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                var = cge_risk_ready_order
                                value = cge_slot_[SLOT]_capture_order
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_zero_since
                    }
                }
                SLOT = "[?cge_risk_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
    }
}
cge_risk_resolve_pending = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = cge_risk_ready_slot
                NOT = {
                    has_country_flag = cge_risk_notice_pending
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_risk_slot
                value = cge_risk_ready_slot
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_risk_expected_order
                value = cge_risk_ready_order
            }
            clear_variable = cge_risk_ready_slot
            cge_risk_observe_slot = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = cge_risk_ready_slot
                }
                save_event_target_as = cge_risk_captor
                meta_effect = {
                    text = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_capture_order
                                    value = cge_risk_expected_order
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                            clear_array = cge_risk_general_display
                            clear_array = cge_risk_origin_display
                            var:cge_slot_[SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                save_event_target_as = cge_risk_general
                                OWNER = {
                                    save_event_target_as = cge_risk_origin
                                }
                            }
                            add_to_array = {
                                array = cge_risk_general_display
                                value = event_target:cge_risk_general
                            }
                            add_to_array = {
                                array = cge_risk_origin_display
                                value = event_target:cge_risk_origin
                            }
                            set_country_flag = cge_risk_notice_pending
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_type
                                        value = 1
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_suicide = 1
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_executed = 1
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_type = 0
                                }
                                clear_variable = cge_slot_[SLOT]_risk_zero_since
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_patience_operation_pending = 0
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_cooperation_operation_pending = 0
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_patience_selected_action = 0
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_cooperation_selected_action = 0
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_patience_timer_running = 0
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_[SLOT]_cooperation_timer_running = 0
                                }
                                clr_country_flag = cge_show_overview_window
                                clear_array = cge_general_display_characters
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot_ctx = [SLOT]
                                }
                                cge_execute_selected_general = yes
                                clear_variable = cge_slot_ctx
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_slot = [SLOT]
                                }
                                cge_mirror_slot_to_character = yes
                                country_event = {
                                    id = cge_risk.1
                                }
                            }
                            else = {
                                event_target:cge_risk_general = {
                                    release_from_captivity = yes
                                    cge_return_clear_character_status = yes
                                    clear_variable = cge_native_captor
                                }
                                event_target:cge_risk_origin = {
                                    if = {
                                        limit = {
                                            exists = yes
                                        }
                                        add_war_support = 0.05
                                    }
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    cge_release_slot_to_remove = [SLOT]
                                }
                                cge_release_remove_selected_slot = yes
                                country_event = {
                                    id = cge_risk.2
                                }
                            }
                            add_political_power = -50
                            add_war_support = -0.05
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_government = democratic
                                }
                                add_popularity = {
                                    ideology = democratic
                                    popularity = -0.05
                                }
                            }
                            else_if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_government = fascism
                                }
                                add_popularity = {
                                    ideology = fascism
                                    popularity = -0.05
                                }
                            }
                            else_if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_government = communism
                                }
                                add_popularity = {
                                    ideology = communism
                                    popularity = -0.05
                                }
                            }
                            else_if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_government = neutrality
                                }
                                add_popularity = {
                                    ideology = neutrality
                                    popularity = -0.05
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    SLOT = "[?cge_risk_slot|.0]"
                }
                cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
                cge_recalc_patience_modifiers = yes
                cge_update_consumer_penalty = yes
            }
        }
        clear_variable = cge_risk_ready_slot
        clear_variable = cge_risk_ready_order
        clear_variable = cge_risk_expected_order
    }

cge_restore_missing_recruited_records = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_roster_captor
        clr_country_flag = cge_roster_restored_any
        every_army_leader = {
            include_invisible = yes
            limit = {
                has_character_flag = cge_recruited_by_player
                NOT = {
                    has_character_flag = cge_roster_retired
                }
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_cge_origin_country^num
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
                var:cge_cge_captor_country^0 = {
                    tag = event_target:cge_roster_captor
                }
            }
            save_event_target_as = cge_roster_general
            event_target:cge_roster_captor = {
                clr_country_flag = cge_roster_general_found
                for_loop_effect = {
                    start = 1
                    end = cge_captured_general_count
                    compare = less_than_or_equals
                    value = cge_roster_check_slot
                    meta_effect = {
                        text = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                                        value = event_target:cge_roster_general
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                }
                                set_country_flag = cge_roster_general_found
                            }
                        }
                        CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_roster_check_slot|.0]"
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_roster_general_found
                        }
                    }
                    cge_restore_recruited_record = yes
                    set_country_flag = cge_roster_restored_any
                }
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = cge_roster_general_found
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = cge_roster_restored_any
            }
            clr_country_flag = cge_roster_restored_any
            cge_refresh_list_after_change = yes
        }
    }
}

# ===== cge_selected_portrait_effects.txt =====
cge_refresh_selected_portrait_keys = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled }
            has_variable = cge_selected_general
            check_variable = { var = cge_overview_selected_slot value = 0 compare = greater_than }
            NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_overview_selected_character_key value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
            NOT = { check_variable = { var = cge_overview_selected_runtime_portrait_key value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:cge_selected_general = {
                    check_variable = { var = cge_cge_runtime_portrait_key value = 0 compare = greater_than }
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_overview_selected_runtime_portrait_key
                value = var:cge_selected_general.cge_cge_runtime_portrait_key
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                var:cge_selected_general = {
                    check_variable = { var = cge_cge_character_key value = 0 compare = greater_than }
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_overview_selected_character_key
                value = var:cge_selected_general.cge_cge_character_key
            }
        }
    }
}

        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_state_rescue_refresh_pending
                        }
                        has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                        has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        NOT = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruited
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_country_flag = cge_state_rescue_refresh_pending
                    country_event = {
                        id = cge_state_rescue_refresh.1
                        hours = 1
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot_arg|.0]"
        }
    }

cge_slot_postwar_watch = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^num
                            value = 0
                            compare = greater_than
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                        var:original_tag = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_postwar_watched_origin
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                                    has_country_flag = cge_postwar_was_at_war_with_player
                                }
                                event_target:cge_postwar_watched_origin = {
                                    has_country_flag = cge_postwar_was_at_war_with_player
                                }
                                any_enemy_country = {
                                    original_tag = event_target:cge_postwar_watched_origin
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                set_character_flag = cge_postwar_tracking_initialized
                                set_character_flag = cge_postwar_war_pending
                            }
                        }
                        set_country_flag = cge_postwar_watch_has_pending_origin
                        set_country_flag = cge_postwar_watch_active
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                has_character_flag = cge_postwar_war_pending
                            }
                        }
                        set_country_flag = cge_postwar_watch_has_pending_origin
                        set_country_flag = cge_postwar_watch_active
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_return_pending
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        set_country_flag = cge_return_stuck_pending_detected
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot_arg|.0]"
        }
    }
}

cge_slot_sync_patience_decay = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_pow_collaborator
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_patience_weekly_decay = -1
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience
                                    value = 75
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_overview_cooperation_weekly_decay = -0.5
                            }
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience
                                    value = 50
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_overview_cooperation_weekly_decay = -1
                            }
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience
                                    value = 25
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_overview_cooperation_weekly_decay = -1.5
                            }
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_overview_cooperation_weekly_decay = -2
                            }
                        }
                        else = {
                            set_variable = {
                                cge_overview_cooperation_weekly_decay = -3
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_operation_pending
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_patience_selected_action
                                value = 1
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_overview_patience_weekly_decay = -2
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_eased_patience_protection_days_left
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                                AND = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_cooperation_operation_pending
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                    check_variable = {

                                has_character_flag = cge_pow_recruitment_unlocked
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country^0 = {
                            NOT = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_pow_weekly_processed
                            }
                        }

                        set_country_flag = cge_pow_weekly_processed
                        set_country_flag = cge_pow_work_origin

                    }
                    cge_pow_refresh = yes

                        var = cge_pow_current_baseline

                    cge_pow_find_recruiter_mark = yes

                                compare = less_than
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_pow_work_initialized = 1
                        }

                            var = cge_pow_work_highwater
                            value = cge_pow_current_baseline

                    cge_pow_calc_work_values = yes

                        value = cge_pow_weekly_gain
                    }
                    add_to_variable = {

                        value = cge_pow_weekly_delta
                    }
                    cge_pow_calc_work_values = yes
                    cge_pow_store_pool = yes

                        clr_country_flag = cge_pow_work_origin
