cge_init_slots = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_list_slot_iterator_1
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_slot
                value = cge_list_slot_iterator_1
            }
            cge_init_slot = yes
        }
    }
}
cge_rebuild_display_unsorted = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_array = cge_general_display_characters
        set_variable = {
            cge_visible_count = 0
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_captured_general_count
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_list_slot_iterator_2
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_slot
                value = cge_list_slot_iterator_2
            }
            cge_init_slot = yes
            meta_effect = {
                text = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                            OR = {
                                has_country_flag = cge_show_executed_generals
                                NOT = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_general_display_characters
                            value = var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        }
                        add_to_variable = {
                            cge_visible_count = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
                CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot|.0]"
            }
        }
    }
}

cge_consider_sort_candidate = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                        OR = {
                            has_country_flag = cge_show_executed_generals
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_cge_sort_epoch
                                    value = PREV.cge_sort_epoch
                                    compare = equals
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    cge_load_candidate_sort_key = yes
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_best_found
                                value = 0
                                compare = equals
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            cge_best_found = 1
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_best_key
                            value = cge_candidate_key
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_best_order
                            value = cge_candidate_order
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_sort_best_character
                        }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                AND = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_sort_desc
                                        value = 0
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_candidate_key
                                        value = cge_best_key
                                        compare = greater_than
                                    }
                                }
                                AND = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_sort_desc
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                    }
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_candidate_key
                                        value = cge_best_key
                                        compare = less_than
                                    }
                                }
                                AND = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_candidate_key
                                        value = cge_best_key
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_candidate_order
                                        value = cge_best_order
                                        compare = less_than
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_best_key
                            value = cge_candidate_key
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_best_order
                            value = cge_candidate_order
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            save_event_target_as = cge_sort_best_character
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot|.0]"
        }
    }
}
cge_sort_display = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        clear_array = cge_general_display_characters
        add_to_variable = {
            cge_sort_epoch = 1
        }
        set_variable = {
            cge_sort_passes = cge_captured_general_count
        }
        for_loop_effect = {
            start = 1
            end = cge_sort_passes
            compare = less_than_or_equals
            value = cge_sort_pass
            set_variable = {
                cge_best_found = 0
            }
            for_loop_effect = {
                start = 1
                end = cge_captured_general_count
                compare = less_than_or_equals
                value = cge_list_slot_iterator_3
                set_variable = {
                    var = cge_slot
                    value = cge_list_slot_iterator_3
                }
                cge_consider_sort_candidate = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_best_found
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                add_to_array = {
                    array = cge_general_display_characters
                    value = event_target:cge_sort_best_character
                }
                event_target:cge_sort_best_character = {
                    set_variable = {
                        var = cge_cge_sort_epoch
                        value = PREV.cge_sort_epoch
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            var = cge_visible_count
            value = cge_general_display_characters^num
        }
    }
}

    }
}

    }

cge_cycle_sort_field = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_sort_field
                    value = cge_sort_requested_field
                    compare = equals
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable = {
                        var = cge_sort_desc
                        value = 0
                        compare = greater_than
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_sort_desc = 0
                }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = {
                    cge_sort_field = 8
                }
                set_variable = {
                    cge_sort_desc = 0
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = {
                var = cge_sort_field
                value = cge_sort_requested_field
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_sort_desc = 1
            }
        }
        cge_sort_display = yes
        clear_variable = cge_sort_requested_field
    }
}
cge_reapply_sort = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = cge_sort_field
                check_variable = {
                    var = cge_sort_field
                    value = 0
                    compare = greater_than
                }
            }
            cge_sort_display = yes
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = {
                cge_sort_field = 8
            }
            set_variable = {
                cge_sort_desc = 0
            }
            cge_sort_display = yes
        }
    }
}

cge_repair_slot_reference = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_global_flag = cge_logic_disabled
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = cge_binding_captor
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_event_target = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            event_target:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                                OR = {
                                    AND = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_registry_character_key
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_registry_character_key
                                            value = PREV.cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_character_key
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                    }
                                    AND = {
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_runtime_prisoner_id
                                            value = 0
                                            compare = greater_than
                                        }
                                        check_variable = {
                                            var = cge_runtime_prisoner_id
                                            value = PREV.cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_prisoner_id
                                            compare = equals
                                        }
                                        var:cge_cge_captor_country^0 = {
                                            tag = event_target:cge_binding_captor
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            value = event_target:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                        }
                        for_each_scope_loop = {
                            array = cge_general_display_characters
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    OR = {
                                        AND = {
                                            check_variable = {
                                                var = cge_registry_character_key
                                                value = 0
                                                compare = greater_than
                                            }
                                            check_variable = {
                                                var = cge_registry_character_key
                                                value = event_target:cge_binding_captor.cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_character_key
                                                compare = equals
                                            }
                                        }
                                        AND = {
                                            check_variable = {
                                                var = cge_runtime_prisoner_id
                                                value = 0
                                                compare = greater_than
                                            }
                                            check_variable = {
                                                var = cge_runtime_prisoner_id
                                                value = event_target:cge_binding_captor.cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_prisoner_id
                                                compare = equals
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                event_target:cge_binding_captor = {
                                    set_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                                        value = PREV
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                            }
                            check_variable = {
                                var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_character_key
                                value = 0
                                compare = greater_than
                            }
                        }
                        every_country = {
                            every_army_leader = {
                                include_invisible = yes
                                limit = {
                                    check_variable = {
                                        var = cge_registry_character_key
                                        value = event_target:cge_binding_captor.cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_character_key
                                        compare = equals
                                    }
                                }
                                event_target:cge_binding_captor = {
                                    set_variable = {
                                        var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                                        value = PREV
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_country_flag = cge_has_candidate_[CGE_SLOT]
                        has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_binding_version
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_recruited
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                check_variable = {
                                    var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_executed
                                    value = 0
                                    compare = greater_than
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        var:cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_leader = {
                            OWNER = {
                                save_event_target_as = cge_binding_origin
                            }
                        }
                        clear_array = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country
                        add_to_array = {
                            array = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_origin_country
                            value = event_target:cge_binding_origin
                        }
                    }
                    clear_array = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_captor_country
                    add_to_array = {
                        array = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_captor_country
                        value = THIS
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_binding_version = 1
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable = {
                            var = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_character_key
                            value = 725
                            compare = equals
                        }
                    }
                    clear_variable = cge_slot_[CGE_SLOT]_runtime_portrait_key
                }
            }
            CGE_SLOT = "[?cge_slot|.0]"
        }
    }
}
